title: Among Us
why_it_hit: Lockdown + streamers + it runs on any phone. Lying to friends is the content.
core_loop: Crewmates do small tasks around a map → impostor secretly kills → body reported → everyone argues in a meeting → vote someone out → repeat until tasks finished or impostors equal crew.
mechanics: Hidden roles assigned at start; task bar shared by all crew (progress = win condition); impostor kill cooldown, vents to teleport, sabotage (lights, reactor, O2) that forces crew to split; emergency button with limited uses; text/voice discussion phase with timer; ghosts keep doing tasks after death.
design: Top-down 2D, bean-shaped characters with only colour + hat as identity; vision radius cone (dark outside it); simple minigame tasks (wires, swipe card, download); loud red "EJECTED" screen; very readable map with rooms + corridors.
build_prompt: Build an original top-down 2D social-deduction party game for 4–10 players. Players are cute blob astronauts/creatures on a small map of 8–10 rooms connected by corridors. 1–2 are secret saboteurs. Others complete 10 short minigame tasks (drag wires, hold button, slide sliders, tap in order) that fill a shared progress bar. Saboteurs can eliminate players (cooldown 25s), use hidden tunnels between rooms, and trigger sabotages (lights out = vision shrinks, timed crisis that needs 2 players at 2 stations). Finding a body or pressing the alarm opens a meeting: 45s discussion, then vote, highest vote is ejected with a dramatic reveal. Eliminated players become ghosts that can still do tasks. Include limited vision radius, colour + hat customisation, and AI bots for solo testing.

title: Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout
why_it_hit: Free on PS Plus at launch, hilarious ragdoll fails, game-show energy, readable for viewers.
core_loop: 60 players → series of 4–5 random minigame rounds → a % qualify each round → final round crowns one winner.
mechanics: Races (obstacle course), survival (stay on spinning platforms), team games (push ball into goal, egg grab), hunt rounds (tail tag). Only 3 verbs: run, jump, dive, grab. Physics ragdoll on hits. Elimination quotas per round.
design: Candy pastel colours, jellybean characters, giant soft obstacles (spinning hammers, pendulums, fans, collapsing hex tiles), costume cosmetics, cheerful game-show music and announcer UI.
build_prompt: Build an original 3D (or 2.5D) party-knockout game: 30 jelly-bean players (fill with bots) compete across 4 randomly chosen rounds. Round types: obstacle race (first 70% to finish qualify), survival (last 50% standing on falling hex tiles), team (push a giant ball into your goal), tail-tag (hold a tail when timer ends). Controls: move, jump, dive, grab. Characters ragdoll when hit by spinning bars, pendulums, bouncers or conveyor belts. Final round is a crown-grab on a moving tower. Pastel colours, rounded geometry, wobbly squash-and-stretch animation, game-show announcer banners ("QUALIFIED!", "ELIMINATED!"), confetti on win.

title: Hades
why_it_hit: Combat that feels perfect + story that progresses *because* you die. Every run gives new dialogue.
core_loop: Pick weapon → fight through rooms → choose 1 of 3 god "boons" (upgrades) after each room → boss every biome → die → return to hub → spend meta currency → retry.
mechanics: Attack, special, cast (ranged), dash with i-frames; boons from different gods that modify each button (e.g., attack applies poison); "duo boons" when you combine two gods; room rewards shown on the door before entering (choose your path); meta upgrades (mirror talents); difficulty modifiers ("heat") for replay.
design: Painted 2D characters over 3D isometric arenas, strong colour per god, big readable telegraphs on enemy attacks, hit-stop and screen shake, voiced characters, rock/Greek-inspired music.
build_prompt: Build an original isometric action roguelite. The hero escapes a layered underworld through 4 biomes of ~10 rooms each plus a boss. Controls: attack (3-hit combo), special, ranged cast that lodges in enemies, dash with invincibility frames. After each cleared room, offer 3 upgrade cards from 6 elemental patrons, each modifying a specific button (fire attack, frost dash, lightning cast…), with rare "combo" upgrades that need two patrons. Doors show the reward icon before you enter. On death, return to a hub where you spend currency on permanent upgrades and talk to NPCs whose dialogue changes based on how you died. Include 5 weapon types, enemy attack telegraphs (red ground markings), hit-stop on impact, and a heat/difficulty modifier system.

title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
why_it_hit: Released exactly when lockdown started; a calm island with friends that runs on real-time.
core_loop: Wake up → collect fruit/shells/fossils, fish, catch bugs → sell for currency → pay off loans → craft furniture → decorate island → villagers move in → daily events.
mechanics: Real-time clock (seasons, day/night, which fish appear); DIY crafting with recipes; tool durability; terraforming; museum collection log; villager friendship; turnip stock market; island rating stars.
design: Soft round art, chunky tiles, curved horizon "rolling log" camera, cosy music that changes every hour, no failure state.
build_prompt: Build an original cosy island life-sim. Player arrives on a small deserted island with a tent. Real-time day/night and seasons. Activities: shake trees for fruit, fish (wait for bite, tap at the right moment), catch bugs with a net, dig fossils, collect shells. Sell items to a shop, pay off a house loan in stages to upgrade the house. Craft tools and furniture from recipes (wood, stone, iron). Place furniture freely inside and outside. Animal neighbours move in, have daily dialogue, give gifts, and have friendship levels. Add a museum that tracks collected species, a weekly fluctuating crop-price market, and an island rating. Soft pastel palette, rounded shapes, curved-world camera effect, hourly music changes.

title: Genshin Impact
why_it_hit: Console-quality open world free on phones, anime art, constant updates, character collection.
core_loop: Explore → climb/glide → solve shrines/puzzles → fight using a 4-character party you swap instantly → collect materials → level characters/weapons → pull new characters with gacha.
mechanics: Elemental reactions (Pyro + Hydro = Vaporize, Cryo + Hydro = Freeze, etc.); instant party swap; stamina for climb/sprint/glide; resin (energy) for boss rewards; artifact gear with random substats; pity system on banners; daily commissions.
design: Cel-shaded anime characters, painterly skies, huge view distances, climbable everything, elemental colour language (red fire, blue water, purple electro).
build_prompt: Build an original open-world action RPG with a party of 4 characters, swap with keys 1–4 instantly. Each character has an element (fire, water, ice, lightning, wind, earth) with normal attack, skill (cooldown), and ultimate (charged by energy orbs). Implement elemental reactions: fire+water = big damage, water+ice = freeze, lightning+water = chain shock, wind spreads elements. Player can climb any surface and glide (stamina bar). World has puzzle shrines, treasure chests, waypoints to fast travel. Characters level up with materials; equipment pieces have random stats. Cel-shaded anime style, bright skies, element colour coding.

title: Call of Duty: Warzone
why_it_hit: Free, AAA gunplay, the Gulag gave a second chance, cash economy made it different.
core_loop: Drop in → loot guns/armor plates → do contracts for cash → buy loadout drop → fight → circle closes → last team wins.
mechanics: Gulag (1v1 duel to respawn); buy stations (loadouts, UAV, self-revive, teammate buyback); armor plates; contracts (bounty, scavenger, recon); gas circle; vehicles; pings.
design: Realistic military look, huge city map, strong audio cues (footsteps), kill-feed, minimap with UAV pings.
build_prompt: Build an original battle-royale shooter (top-down or 3D) for up to 50 players/bots. Players drop onto a map with towns, loot weapons of rarity tiers and armor plates. Cash drops from enemies and crates; spend cash at buy stations on custom loadouts, radar scans, and teammate revives. On first death, the player goes to a "duel pit" for a 1v1 to earn a respawn. Optional contracts: hunt a marked player, open 3 caches, capture an area. A toxic zone shrinks in 6 phases. Include vehicles, ping system, armor plating animation, and realistic muted colour palette.

title: Valorant
why_it_hit: CS-style precise gunplay + hero abilities, low-spec, free, esports-ready.
core_loop: Buy phase → attackers plant bomb ("spike") or eliminate defenders → defenders defuse or eliminate → first to 13 rounds.
mechanics: One life per round; economy (win/loss bonus); agents with 4 abilities (smoke, flash, wall, heal, recon); first-shot accuracy, recoil patterns, run-and-gun inaccuracy; ultimate orbs.
design: Clean stylised readable art, bright enemy outlines, high contrast maps with 2–3 bombsites, clear ability visual language.
build_prompt: Build an original 5v5 round-based tactical shooter. Attackers must plant a device at site A or B; defenders stop them. One life per round, first to 7 rounds. Each round starts with a 20s buy phase using credits earned from kills and round results. Choose from 6 heroes each with 3 abilities + 1 ultimate: smoke screen, blinding flash, wall, healing, scan dart, teleport. Gun accuracy drops while moving; recoil pattern climbs up. Stylised clean art, bright enemy outlines, minimal clutter. Add bots for offline play.

title: Phasmophobia
why_it_hit: Voice recognition (ghost hears you say its name), streamer screams, investigative gameplay.
core_loop: Choose contract → bring equipment into a haunted house → collect 3 pieces of evidence → identify ghost type in journal → survive hunts → get paid → buy better gear.
mechanics: Evidence types (EMF 5, spirit box, fingerprints, ghost orb, writing, freezing temp, DOTS); sanity meter drops in dark; hunts where ghost kills you; crucifix/smudge sticks; voice chat proximity; ghost-specific behaviour tells.
design: Realistic dark houses, flashlight cone, VHS camera, silence then sudden noises, minimal UI.
build_prompt: Build an original co-op paranormal investigation game. Players enter a dark house with a van full of tools: EM meter, thermometer, UV light, voice box, camera, notebook. Each ghost type (10 types) leaves exactly 3 of 7 evidence types. Players log evidence in a journal that narrows down the type. Team sanity drops in darkness; low sanity triggers "hunts" where lights flicker, doors lock and the ghost chases—hide or use a protective item. Correct identification pays money to buy better gear. Use a flashlight cone, heavy ambience, sudden audio stingers, minimal HUD.

title: Ghost of Tsushima
why_it_hit: Gorgeous art direction, wind guides you (no clutter UI), cinematic duels.
core_loop: Explore island → liberate camps → stand-offs/duels → stealth or open combat → upgrade gear → story missions.
mechanics: Guiding wind instead of waypoint; combat stances (each counters an enemy type); parry/perfect dodge; stand-off quick-draw; stealth assassinations; haiku/hot springs collectibles.
design: Bold colour fields (red maple, golden grass, white flowers), wind physics on grass, Kurosawa-style black-and-white mode, minimal HUD.
build_prompt: Build an original open-world swordsman action game in a stylised feudal setting. No minimap: a wind effect blows grass and leaves toward the objective. Combat: 4 stances, each strong vs one enemy type (shield, spear, brute, swordsman); parry with perfect timing, dodge, heavy attack. Stand-off: at enemy camps, challenge to a quick-draw where you release the button at the exact moment the enemy attacks. Stealth assassinations from tall grass. Fields of strong single colour (red trees, gold grass, white flowers), cinematic duels, optional black-and-white filter.

title: The Last of Us Part II
why_it_hit: Best-in-class animation, brutal story, accessible options set a new standard.
mechanics: Crafting from scavenged parts; prone stealth in grass; dodge button; enemies with names who call out to each other; dogs track scent; limited ammo; weapon workbenches; listen mode.
design: Ultra-realistic overgrown cities, grounded animation, enemy chatter, 60+ accessibility options.
build_prompt: Build an original third-person survival action game in an overgrown, abandoned city. Scarce resources: craft medkits, bombs and silencers from scavenged parts. Stealth through tall grass while prone; enemies patrol in squads, call each other by name, and search last-known positions. Tracker dogs follow your scent trail. Infected enemies react to sound; some are blind and detect only noise. Add a "listen" mode that shows enemies through walls briefly, weapon upgrade benches, and detailed accessibility options (high contrast mode, aim assist, slow motion).

title: Cyberpunk 2077
mechanics: Cyberware implants (double jump, blades, slow-mo); hacking enemies (quickhacks); stats + perk trees; netrunning; vehicles; branching quests with consequences; police heat system.
design: Dense neon vertical megacity, ads everywhere, rain-reflective streets, synthwave soundtrack.
build_prompt: Build an original first-person (or top-down) neon cyber-city RPG. Player installs cyber implants into body slots (eyes, arms, legs, nervous system) for powers: double jump, arm blades, time slow on dodge, see through walls. Hack enemies, cameras and turrets from range using a RAM bar (short-circuit, blind, make them shoot each other). Five attributes and perk trees. Quest choices change who lives and which ending. Police heat stars rise with crimes. Rainy night city, holographic signage, magenta/cyan palette.

title: DOOM Eternal
why_it_hit: "Combat chess" — resource loop forces aggression.
mechanics: Glory kills give health; chainsaw gives ammo; flame belch gives armor; dash ×2; weak points on demons; weapon mods; monkey bars; extra lives.
design: Heavy metal music that intensifies, bright pickups bursting from enemies, colour-coded resource drops.
build_prompt: Build an original fast arena shooter where resources come only from enemies: melee-finishing a staggered enemy drops health, cutting an enemy with a fuel tool drops ammo, setting enemies on fire makes them drop armor. Player has double-jump, two air dashes, and swings on bars. Enemies have destructible weak points (shoot off the turret arm). 8 weapons with alternate mods. Waves spawn in arenas; music shifts into heavy mode during fights. Colour-coded pickups: green health, orange ammo, blue armor.

title: Half-Life: Alyx
why_it_hit: Proved VR could carry a full AAA game; every object is physical and touchable.
mechanics: "Gravity gloves" — point at a distant object, flick the wrist and catch it; manual reloading (eject mag, grab new from shoulder, insert, rack); limited ammo and resin crafting at upgrade stations; holographic hacking puzzles (rotate spheres, trace lines); wrist pockets as inventory; physics props everywhere (bottles, buckets you can wear as helmets); enemies that leap at your face; darkness + flashlight.
design: Dense, hand-crafted environments; tension from slow, deliberate pacing; comfort options (teleport, smooth locomotion, seated mode).
build_prompt: Build an original first-person physics adventure (VR-ready, with a mouse fallback). Gloves let the player lock onto distant objects and flick them into the hand. Reload manually in 3 steps (eject, insert, rack). Inventory is 2 wrist slots and a backpack over the shoulder. Hack terminals by solving short 3D holographic puzzles (rotate rings to align a laser). Every prop is physics-driven and can be stacked, thrown or worn. Dark industrial levels with parasite creatures that leap at the face, flashlight on the hand, and crafting stations that upgrade weapons with collected resin.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator
why_it_hit: The entire Earth streamed from satellite + map data; fly over your own house.
mechanics: Real-world terrain and cities; live weather and air traffic; realistic aerodynamics; detailed clickable cockpits; flight school tutorials; landing challenges with leaderboards; bush trips (VFR navigation); assistance sliders from casual to full realism.
design: Photoreal clouds and lighting, cinematic replays, modular difficulty assists.
build_prompt: Build an original small-scale flight game: procedurally generated terrain with mountains, rivers, towns and 3 airstrips. Plane physics with throttle, pitch, roll, yaw, flaps; lift depends on speed and angle of attack; stall warning and buffet. Missions: land on a short strip, follow a river to a village, deliver cargo, fly through a storm, survive crosswind. Day/night and weather (rain, wind, fog). HUD shows altitude, speed, heading, vertical speed, fuel. Landing score based on touchdown speed and centreline. Assist sliders from arcade to realistic.

title: Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales
why_it_hit: Best-feeling traversal in games, compact story, PS5 launch showcase.
mechanics: Momentum web-swinging (rope physics from buildings), wall-run, point-launch, web-zip; combo melee with dodge prompts (spider-sense); electric "venom" special attacks fuelled by a combo bar; temporary invisibility to reset fights and do stealth takedowns; side crimes, collectibles and challenge drones.
design: Snowy city at Christmas, comic-panel style hit effects, hip-hop + orchestral score, quick loading.
build_prompt: Build an original swinging-hero open city game. Swinging uses physics ropes attached to building tops: hold to swing, release at the bottom of the arc to fling, wall-run up buildings, point-launch to ledges. Combat: 3-hit combos, dodge when a danger indicator flashes, rope-pull enemies, air juggling, and a charged electric burst special filled by combos. A short invisibility power lets you vanish and perform stealth takedowns. Snowy city with festive lights, random street crimes, races and collectibles.

title: Demon's Souls (Remake)
why_it_hit: PS5 launch graphics showcase and remake of the game that started the souls genre.
mechanics: Hub (Nexus) linking 5 worlds × 3–4 stages; stamina combat (attack, block, roll, parry, backstab); souls (currency) dropped on death and recoverable once; body/soul form (soul form = reduced max HP); world tendency (black/white world states change enemies and secrets); shortcuts back to checkpoints; weight-based roll speed.
design: Gothic, foggy, oppressive; bosses as puzzles; readable telegraphs.
build_prompt: Build an original dark fantasy action RPG with stamina-based combat (attack, block, roll, parry all cost stamina). A central hub links 5 worlds, each with 3 stages ending in a boss. On death, drop all currency where you died; reach it to recover; die again and it's gone. Dying puts you in "spirit form" with 75% max HP until you defeat a boss. Each world has a light/dark state that shifts with your actions and unlocks secret areas. Shortcuts open back to checkpoints. Gloomy, foggy, gothic art.

title: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
why_it_hit: Gorgeous hand-painted art, emotional story, ultra-fluid movement.
mechanics: Bash (freeze time near enemy/projectile, aim, launch off it while redirecting it); double jump, dash, grapple, burrow through sand, swim, glide on feather; spirit shards (equippable perks, 3–8 slots); spirit trials (races vs ghosts); escape chase sequences; ability-gated map.
design: Glowing spirit in dark forests, deep parallax, orchestral score, tear-jerking cutscenes.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D metroidvania with a glowing spirit hero. Signature move "bash": near an enemy or projectile, freeze time, aim, and launch yourself off it while flinging it the opposite way. Unlock double jump, grapple, dash, burrow through sand, swim and glide. Equip up to 3 perk shards from a collection of 20. Include 3 high-speed escape chase sequences, timed race trials against ghosts, glowing painted forest backgrounds with deep parallax, and an ability-gated map.

title: Crusader Kings III
why_it_hit: Made Paradox approachable; endless emergent drama stories ("my king married his rival's mother").
mechanics: You play a dynasty, not a country; when ruler dies you continue as heir; traits, stress, opinions; schemes (murder, seduce, fabricate claims); marriages for alliances; inheritance law splits realm; vassals, councils, faiths, cultures; lifestyle perk trees; event pop-ups with choices.
design: 3D map with portraits that age; tooltips inside tooltips.
build_prompt: Build an original medieval dynasty simulator. You control a ruler; on death you continue as their heir. Characters have traits (brave, greedy, paranoid), age, health, opinions and stress (rises when acting against personality). Arrange marriages for alliances; run schemes (assassinate, befriend, fabricate claim) with success %. Inheritance splits land among children unless laws change. Map of counties/duchies/kingdoms; wars use levies and knights. Event pop-ups with 2–3 choices that change traits. Aging character portraits.

title: Spiritfarer
why_it_hit: Emotionally powerful "cosy game about dying"; beautiful hand-drawn art.
mechanics: Boat you expand with buildings stacked in a grid (garden, kitchen, sawmill, loom, forge); animal-spirit passengers with moods, favourite foods and quests; resource minigames (catch lightning, fish, jellyfish harvest); hugging; delivering spirits to a final gate; co-op with a cat.
design: Hand-drawn 2D animation, warm colours, gentle score.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D cosy management game on a ferry boat. Build rooms on the deck in a grid (garden, kitchen, sawmill, loom). Passengers (animal spirits) have moods, favourite meals and requests. Sail to islands to gather resources via small platforming minigames (catch lightning in a bottle, net glowing jellyfish, fish). When a passenger's story is complete, sail them to a final gate for an emotional farewell. Hand-drawn art, warm colours, gentle music.

title: Astro's Playroom
why_it_hit: Pure delight and nostalgia; showed off new controller features.
mechanics: 4 worlds based on console parts (CPU Plaza, Cooling Springs, GPU Jungle, Memory Meadow); each with transformation levels (spring frog suit, rolling ball, monkey climbing suit, rocket); collectibles (puzzle pieces, artifacts shown in a museum); spin and hover jump.
design: Toy-like bright colours, hundreds of cameo robots, punchy SFX, tactile feedback.
build_prompt: Build an original cheerful 3D platformer with a tiny robot hero across 4 themed worlds. Each world mixes classic platforming with a transformation level (spring suit that charges big jumps, rolling ball suit, climbing monkey suit, rocket ship). Collect coins, puzzle pieces and hidden artifacts displayed in a museum hub. Bright toy-like colours, dancing cameo robots in the background, punchy sound effects.

title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
why_it_hit: Viking fantasy, huge world, raids and settlement building.
mechanics: Longboat raids with crew (blow horn to start); settlement building unlocks features; skill constellation web; dual-wield any weapons; stealth assassinations; mini-games (insult-poetry battles, dice board game, drinking contests); world events.
design: Nordic & English landscapes, mist, golden light.
build_prompt: Build an original open-world raiding RPG. Sail a longboat along rivers with a crew; blow a horn to start raids on fortified sites, crew fights alongside you. Loot builds a home settlement (blacksmith, barracks, stable, tavern) that unlocks features. Dual-wield any two weapons. Skill web arranged like constellations. Side activities: rhythm-rhyme insult battles, a dice board game, cairn stone stacking.

title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
why_it_hit: Modernised a legend with hybrid action/tactical combat.
mechanics: Real-time attacks fill ATB gauge; spend ATB in "tactical mode" (time slows) on abilities, spells, items; pressure → stagger with damage multiplier; materia orbs socketed in weapon/armour slots and levelled up; 3-member party swap; weapon skill upgrades.
design: Dense steampunk-industrial city, cinematic bosses.
build_prompt: Build an original action-RPG with hybrid combat: basic attacks in real time fill an action gauge; open a command menu (time slows to 10%) to spend gauge segments on skills, spells or items. Enemies have a pressure → stagger meter; staggered enemies take 160%+ damage that grows with hits. Weapons have orb slots where you socket magic orbs (fire, heal, summon) that level up. Switch between 3 party members anytime.

title: Legends of Runeterra
why_it_hit: Generous economy, interactive combat, League of Legends characters.
mechanics: Alternating attack token each round; mana +1/round, unspent saved as spell mana (max 3); spell speeds (burst, fast, slow) allow responses; champions level up after conditions; regions as factions; Path of Champions PvE roguelike.
design: Lively animated board, champion level-up cinematics.
build_prompt: Build an original 1v1 digital card battler. Players alternate who holds the attack token each round. Mana grows by 1 each round; unspent mana (up to 3) is saved for spells. Spells have speeds: instant ones resolve immediately; others can be responded to. Hero cards level up after meeting a condition (e.g., strike twice) and transform with an animation. 6 factions with distinct mechanics. Board has attack/block lanes. Add a PvE roguelike mode.

title: Teardown
why_it_hit: Total destruction + clever "prepare then sprint" heist structure.
mechanics: Fully destructible voxel world; planning phase with unlimited time; pick up first target triggers 60s alarm; tools (sledgehammer, blowtorch, explosives, planks, rope); vehicles; fire spread; modding.
design: Voxel art with modern ray-traced lighting.
build_prompt: Build an original fully destructible voxel heist game. Each level has several targets to steal. Picking up the first target triggers a 60-second alarm; all remaining targets must be grabbed and you must reach the escape vehicle in time. Before triggering, unlimited prep time: smash walls, build ramps, position cars, blow holes. Tools: sledgehammer, blowtorch, explosives, planks. Voxel physics with collapsing structures and fire spread.

title: Paper Mario: The Origami King
why_it_hit: Funny writing and a unique puzzle-based battle system.
mechanics: Ring battle: arena of 4 concentric rings × 12 slices; rotate rings and slide rows to line enemies up within move/time limits; lined-up rows → jump attack, 2×2 blocks → hammer; bosses reversed (you path toward them); confetti to fill holes in the world; 1000-fold arms.
design: Paper-craft world, origami villains.
build_prompt: Build an original papercraft adventure RPG with puzzle battles: enemies stand on a circular arena of 4 rings × 12 slices. Before attacking, the player has limited moves and a timer to rotate rings or slide rows to group enemies into lines (jump attack hits a line) or 2×2 blocks (hammer hits a block). Solving fully grants a damage bonus. Paper-craft world with holes you fill with confetti.

title: Ghostrunner
why_it_hit: Pure flow; one-hit deaths with instant restarts.
mechanics: One-hit kill both ways; instant respawn; wall-run, grapple, slide, air-dash; "sensory boost" slows time mid-air to dodge bullets; sword deflects bullets; ability tree in a Tetris-shaped upgrade grid.
design: Cyberpunk vertical tower, neon, synthwave.
build_prompt: Build an original first-person cyber-ninja parkour game. One hit kills you and one hit kills enemies. Wall-running, grapple points, slide, air-dash with time-slow to dodge bullets, and a sword slash that deflects projectiles. Instant restart at the last checkpoint (under 0.5s). Upgrade abilities by fitting Tetris-shaped chips into a grid. Vertical neon megastructure levels; death counter per level.

title: Immortals Fenyx Rising
why_it_hit: Bright, humorous take on climbing/gliding open worlds.
mechanics: Climb and glide with wings; 40+ puzzle vaults; godly powers (summon spears, spinning axe, ground slam); telekinesis-like lift ability; stamina; narrator duo comedy.
design: Saturated mythic regions themed by gods; cartoon proportions.
build_prompt: Build an original colourful mythology open world with climbing, gliding with wings, and 40 short puzzle vaults (push blocks, shoot targets, redirect light). Combat uses god-given powers (summon spears, spinning axe, ground slam) plus a lift power to carry heavy objects. Two comedic narrators bicker throughout and comment on your actions.

title: Carrion
why_it_hit: "You are the monster" fantasy, incredibly satisfying tentacle movement.
mechanics: Tentacles grab any surface; eat humans to grow bigger; size tiers unlock/limit powers; deposit biomass in pools to shrink; powers: invisibility, web shot, spike armour, possession of humans.
design: Pixel-art lab, gory but cartoonish.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D "reverse horror" game where you play a red blob creature escaping a lab. Tentacles grab surfaces and pull the body anywhere. Eat scientists and guards to grow; bigger = stronger but can't fit through vents. Deposit biomass into pools to shrink when needed. Unlock powers: invisibility, web shot, spike armour, mind-control a human. Guards with flamethrowers, drones and shields fight back.

title: Spelunky 2
why_it_hit: Deep systemic interactions; every run is a story.
mechanics: Levels assembled from hand-made room chunks; 4 HP/bombs/ropes start; shops and angry shopkeepers; mounts; pets to rescue (heal); hidden areas and alternate routes; liquids physics; curses; online co-op.
design: Bright cartoon pixel art, readable traps.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D roguelike cave platformer with procedural levels stitched from hand-designed room chunks. Start with 4 health, 4 bombs, 4 ropes. Bombs destroy terrain, ropes climb up. Shops with shopkeepers who attack if you steal. Systemic interactions: lava, water, arrow traps, rescuable pets that heal you, rideable mounts. Hidden paths to secret areas. Permadeath, 4-player co-op.

title: Star Wars: Squadrons
why_it_hit: Pure dogfighting fantasy, VR support.
mechanics: Cockpit-only view; route power between engines/weapons/shields; missile lock-on and countermeasures; 5v5 Fleet Battles (destroy fighters → frigates → flagship subsystems); component loadouts.
build_prompt: Build an original cockpit-view space dogfighting game. Players route 4 power pips between engines, lasers and shields (more to lasers = faster recharge, etc.). 5v5 fleet battle phases: destroy escort fighters, then frigates, then the enemy flagship's subsystems. Missiles need lock-on; countermeasures break locks. Customise ship parts.

title: Crash Bandicoot 4: It's About Time
why_it_hit: Tough classic platforming with modern polish.
mechanics: Into-screen and side-view corridors; crates and fruit; 4 quantum masks (phase objects, slow time, flip gravity, dash spin); gems for perfect runs; N.Verted mirrored mode; modern (no lives) vs retro mode.
design: Cartoon world, expressive animation.
build_prompt: Build an original linear 3D platformer where levels run toward and away from the camera plus side-scrolling sections. Collect crates and fruit. Four magic masks unlock time-slow, phasing objects in/out of existence, gravity flip, and a dash spin. Gems for breaking every box and not dying. Modern mode with checkpoints and no lives; retro mode with lives. Bright cartoony visuals with a spin attack.

title: Monster Train
why_it_hit: Fresh lane-based twist on Slay the Spire.
mechanics: Defend 3 vertical floors + pyre at top; enemies enter bottom floor and climb after each combat; units and spells cards; pick primary + allied clan (5 clans); artifacts; upgrade forges; Covenant difficulty.
build_prompt: Build an original roguelike deckbuilder with lane strategy: a 3-floor vertical fortress protecting a core. Each turn draw 5 cards; place units on floors or cast spells. Enemies enter the bottom floor and move up after each combat. Pick 2 of 5 factions per run; upgrade cards at forges; artifacts give passive effects; difficulty ranks for replay.

title: Noita
why_it_hit: Every pixel simulated; wand-building madness.
mechanics: Falling-sand simulation (liquids, gases, fire, explosions); wands with spell slots executed in sequence; modifiers + projectiles + triggers; perks; secrets and alchemy.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D falling-sand roguelite where every pixel is simulated: water flows, oil burns, acid melts, gas rises. Player descends through a mine with wands that hold spell slots; arrange spells in order (modifier → projectile → trigger) to create combos. Fire, explosions and liquids constantly change the terrain. Perks between levels.

title: Stumble Guys
why_it_hit: Fall Guys formula on phones for free, short matches.
mechanics: 32 players; 3 rounds (race, survival, final); one-thumb joystick + jump + dive; physics knockbacks; skins, emotes, events; map editor later.
build_prompt: Build an original mobile-first party knockout game with 32 players (bots fill). 3 rounds: obstacle race, survival, last-one-standing. One-thumb joystick + jump + dive. Physics bumpers, swinging hammers, rotating beams. Bright low-poly characters, emotes, skins, 2-minute matches and a quick rematch button.

title: Valheim
why_it_hit: 5 devs, sold millions in weeks; building + boss progression gave survival games a clear goal.
core_loop: Gather wood/stone → build base → craft gear → beat biome boss → boss unlocks next tier material → new biome.
mechanics: Biomes in difficulty order (Meadows → Black Forest → Swamp → Mountain → Plains); structural integrity colours (blue → red); comfort/rested buff; food slots raise HP/stamina; sailing; skills level by use; raids on base.
design: Low-res textures + modern lighting, huge skies, volumetric fog; Norse mood.
build_prompt: Build an original co-op survival game set in a procedurally generated afterlife world with 6 biomes of increasing danger. Gather wood, stone and ore; craft tools and armour at workbenches whose tier upgrades with nearby add-ons. Building uses snap pieces with structural stability (blue = strong, red = about to collapse). Eating up to 3 foods raises max HP/stamina. Each biome has a summonable boss; beating it drops an item that lets you mine the next biome's ore. Skills improve by use. Boats with wind sailing. Low-res pixel textures with modern fog, light shafts and big skies.

title: It Takes Two
why_it_hit: Every level introduces a brand-new mechanic; "friend pass" (one copy for two).
mechanics: Asymmetric abilities per player per chapter (one gets a hammer, the other nails; one sucks with vacuum, other shoots); constant genre swaps (shooter, racing, rhythm, top-down); dozens of mini-games.
design: Pixar-like toy world at tiny scale, vertical split screen, comedy relationship story.
build_prompt: Build an original 2-player split-screen co-op adventure about two tiny toy characters. Every chapter gives each player a different complementary tool: Player 1 throws nails that stick into walls, Player 2 swings a hammer and can swing on stuck nails; next chapter one controls gravity boots while the other shrinks/grows; next one has fire, the other has sap that explodes. Each chapter also swaps genre briefly (top-down shooter, side-scroller, racing, rhythm). Include 10 hidden competitive minigames (whack-a-mole, tug of war). Giant everyday-object world (kitchen, garden, toy room).

title: Resident Evil Village
mechanics: Hub village with 4 themed "lord" areas (castle, doll house, reservoir, factory); merchant shop; hunting animals for permanent upgrades; inventory grid (attaché case Tetris); weapon customisation; puzzle keys.
build_prompt: Build an original first-person horror-action game with a central village hub linking 4 themed areas, each ruled by a boss with its own horror flavour (gothic castle chase, puppet-house pure horror with no weapons, flooded lake, mechanical factory). Grid inventory where items have shapes to fit. Merchant sells weapon upgrades; hunting animals and cooking meals raise permanent stats. Limited ammo, crafted from components.

title: Deathloop
mechanics: Same day repeats (4 time periods × 4 districts); assassinate 8 targets in one loop; knowledge persists; powers (blink, shift link kills); invader player.
build_prompt: Build an original time-loop assassination game. An island day has 4 time periods; each district changes depending on the time. You must eliminate 8 targets in a single day, but they're spread across places and times. Each loop you learn schedules, codes and secrets that persist. Powers: short teleport, link enemies so killing one kills linked, invisibility. A rival (AI or player) hunts you each loop. 60s retro-futurist art.

title: Forza Horizon 5
mechanics: Festival progression; skill chains (drifts, near misses); danger signs (jumps), speed traps; seasonal playlist; car collection; rewind button; barn finds.
build_prompt: Build an original open-world arcade racer set in a sunny country with deserts, jungles and a volcano. Race events (road, dirt, street), skill chains (drift + near-miss + airborne combo multiplier), speed cameras, jump signs with distance score. Rewind button for mistakes. Earn cars from wheelspin lottery and garage collection. Seasonal weather changes. Bright colours, festival banners.

title: Halo Infinite
why_it_hit: Free-to-play multiplayer with classic arena feel; the grappleshot.
mechanics: Everyone spawns equal; power weapons and equipment spawn on timers at fixed map spots; equipment pickups (grappleshot, drop wall, threat sensor, thruster, repulsor); regenerating shields over health; melee, grenades, sprint and slide; Big Team Battle with vehicles; campaign open zone with outposts to capture.
design: Clean sci-fi, colour-coded teams, iconic shield pop sound.
build_prompt: Build an original sci-fi arena shooter: 4v4, everyone spawns with the same rifle and pistol; power weapons and equipment spawn at fixed spots on timers shown on the HUD. Equipment: grapple hook (pull yourself to walls, yank items or enemies), deployable shield wall, threat sensor, short dash thruster. Energy shields regenerate after 4s without damage; health doesn't. Big-team mode adds vehicles. Slide, clamber, sprint. Clean colour-coded red vs blue art.

title: Psychonauts 2
why_it_hit: Creative mind-world levels; big heart about mental health.
mechanics: Each level is inside a character's mind themed on their psyche; psychic powers (levitation ball ride, telekinesis, pyrokinesis, time bubble, mental connection grapple, clairvoyance to see through others' eyes); emotional baggage collectibles; figments; pin perks.
design: Surreal Burton-esque art, wildly different level art per mind.
build_prompt: Build an original 3D platformer where each level is the inside of a character's mind, themed by their personality (a cooking-show mind, a bowling-hospital mind, a music festival mind, a library of memories). Powers: ride a levitation ball, telekinesis, fire, slow-time bubble, grapple onto "thought" nodes. Collect emotional baggage that cries until reunited with its tag, and floating figments. Surreal hand-crafted art that changes completely per level.

title: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
why_it_hit: PS5 showcase: instant loading between dimensions.
mechanics: Rift tether (zip through tears in space); dimension-swap levels via crystals; 20 creative weapons that level up with use; hover boots, wall-run, phantom dash; bolts currency and raritanium upgrades; pocket dimensions.
design: Pixar-quality cartoon visuals, heavy particle effects.
build_prompt: Build an original 3D action platformer with zany gadget weapons that level up through use (a sprinkler that turns enemies into topiary, a mine glove, a black-hole shotgun, a spray of bouncing explosives). Rift tether: aim at glowing tears in space and zip through instantly. Some levels swap between two dimensions when you hit a crystal. Hover boots for speed, wall-run, dash. Collect bolts to buy upgrades.

title: Returnal
why_it_hit: Arcade bullet-hell DNA in a AAA 3D roguelike with a haunting story.
mechanics: Neon bullet patterns in 3D; dash with i-frames; adrenaline levels (3 kills without a hit = level, buffs reset when hit); parasites (buff + debuff); malignant items; overload reload timing; weapon traits; persistent tools unlock new paths.
design: Dark alien biomes contrasted with bright orange/blue bullets; 3D audio.
build_prompt: Build an original third-person bullet-hell roguelike on a hostile alien planet. Enemies fire dense neon orb patterns you dodge with a dash (i-frames). Kills without being hit raise an adrenaline level giving perks; getting hit resets it. Pick up parasites that give one buff and one debuff. Reload has an active timing window for a bonus. Biomes reset each death, but key tools (grapple, blade) persist and open new routes.

title: Inscryption
why_it_hit: Genre-bending mystery, creepy atmosphere, shocking twists.
mechanics: Sacrifice creatures (blood cost) or spend bones; damage tips a scale (5 = win); sigils (flying, poison, guardian) transplanted between cards; roguelike map; get up from the table to solve cabin escape-room puzzles; candles = lives.
design: Candle-lit cabin, wood textures, unsettling dealer eyes in darkness.
build_prompt: Build an original creepy first-person card game played at a table against a mysterious dealer. Cards cost "sacrifices": remove your creatures to summon bigger ones; other cards cost bones gained when creatures die. Damage tips a scale; tip it 5 toward the opponent to win. Cards have ability sigils (flying, poison, guard) that can be moved between cards at a ritual. Between hands, the player can stand up and explore the cabin to solve escape-room puzzles. 2 candles = 2 lives. Dim candlelit art.

title: Loop Hero
why_it_hit: Unusual "you're the world builder, not the hero" twist.
mechanics: Hero walks a loop automatically and auto-fights; you place tile cards (monster spawners, meadows heal, mountains +HP, villages, vampire mansions); adjacency combos; boss spawns after enough tiles; retreat to camp keeps 100% resources (60% if killed); base buildings unlock cards/classes.
design: Retro 8-bit EGA-style pixel art, dark fantasy.
build_prompt: Build an original auto-walk roguelike: a hero walks a looping road on their own and fights automatically. You place tile cards around the loop: monster spawners, meadows (heal), mountains (+HP; 3×3 becomes a peak), villages, etc. Adjacent tiles create combos. Loot drops into gear slots for you to equip. A boss appears after placing enough tiles. Retreat to camp to keep resources for building the base, which unlocks new cards and classes. Retro pixel art.

title: Metroid Dread
why_it_hit: Fast, tense, best-selling entry in the series.
mechanics: EMMI zones (unkillable robot stalkers; near-impossible counter QTE if caught); temporary Omega weapon to destroy each EMMI; melee counter; slide; phantom cloak; flash shift dash; missiles, grapple beam, morph ball.
design: Dark sci-fi, sharp silhouettes, alarm-red EMMI zones.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D sci-fi metroidvania with "hunter zones": unkillable robot stalkers patrol some areas; if caught, a split-second counter or death. Defeat each stalker by getting a temporary super-weapon nearby. Player has a melee counter (parry flash), slide, cloak (drains energy), missiles, grapple and morph-ball forms. Doors and walls gated by abilities.

title: Pokémon UNITE
why_it_hit: Simplified MOBA for mobile/Switch with beloved creatures.
mechanics: Defeat wild creatures for energy; dunk energy into enemy goal zones (channel time scales with amount); creatures evolve mid-match; held items; boost emblems; final 2 minutes: big boss gives instant scoring buff; 10-minute matches.
build_prompt: Build an original 5v5 creature-MOBA: defeat wild creatures to collect energy, then stand on an enemy goal zone to dunk energy for points (bigger dunks take longer). Characters level up and evolve into bigger forms mid-match. Last 2 minutes: a giant boss spawns; defeating it lets the team score instantly. 10-minute matches, mobile-friendly twin-stick controls.

title: New World
why_it_hit: Massive launch interest; real-time action combat in an MMO.
mechanics: Classless — weapon mastery trees; territory control wars between 3 factions; town projects; gathering and crafting trade skills; player market; expeditions (dungeons); corrupted breach events.
build_prompt: Build an original action MMO with classless progression: each weapon has its own mastery tree; equip 2 weapons. 3 factions compete for territory through scheduled PvP sieges. Gather wood, ore and herbs; craft gear; trade at a player market; town projects upgrade crafting stations.

title: Death's Door
why_it_hit: Tight Zelda-meets-souls design, charming crow hero.
mechanics: Melee hits recharge magic; ranged spells (arrow, fire, bomb, hook); dungeons with keys and puzzles; vitality shards; doors as checkpoints; soul upgrades for stats.
design: Muted greys with bright accents, tilt-shift camera, melancholy humour.
build_prompt: Build an original isometric action-adventure starring a little crow who reaps souls. Melee recharges magic energy for ranged spells (arrow, fire, bomb, grappling hook). Dungeons with keys, levers and puzzles; giant bosses. Doors act as checkpoints. Spend souls to upgrade strength, speed, dexterity, magic. Muted grey world with bright accents.

title: Kena: Bridge of Spirits
why_it_hit: Animated-film-quality visuals from a small studio.
mechanics: Tiny companions ("Rot") move objects, form shapes, attack when courage is charged; spirit staff, bow, shield, pulse bomb; corruption cleansing; hats for companions.
build_prompt: Build an original 3D action-adventure where a young spirit guide is helped by dozens of tiny cute companions that move heavy objects, form shapes, and attack enemies when "courage" is charged. Weapons: staff, bow, shield, pulse bomb. Cleanse corrupted areas to restore colour. Hats as collectibles for companions. Lush forest, animated-film style.

title: Dyson Sphere Program
why_it_hit: Factorio-like depth with gorgeous 3D scale across star systems.
mechanics: Mine, smelt, assemble on spherical planets; belts, sorters, logistics stations; interplanetary/interstellar logistics; power progression (wind → solar → fusion); research; build Dyson swarm/sphere.
build_prompt: Build an original factory-automation game: mine ore on planets, place belts, smelters and assemblers to craft components, research tech, ship goods between planets with drones, and ultimately build a mega-structure around a star. Clear production stats panel showing per-minute rates.

title: Unpacking
why_it_hit: Wordless storytelling through a person's belongings.
mechanics: Each level = one move (1997 bedroom → shared flat → home); take items from boxes and place them; some must go in "correct" places (highlighted); recurring items reveal life story.
design: Cosy pixel art, ASMR-like placement sounds.
build_prompt: Build an original pixel-art zen puzzle game: each level is a room in a different stage of life. Unpack boxes one item at a time and place each where it belongs; misplaced items flash red at the end. Recurring items across levels tell a wordless life story. Satisfying placement sounds.

title: Monster Hunter Rise
why_it_hit: Faster, more mobile hunting, great on Switch.
mechanics: Wirebugs (zip through air, silkbind counter attacks); Wyvern Riding (control monsters to fight others); Palamute dog mount; 14 weapon types; hunt → carve → craft set skills; Rampage tower-defence missions.
build_prompt: Build an original monster-hunting action game. Hunt big creatures with readable attack patterns; break parts for rare materials; craft weapons and armour sets with skills. Grappling-wire mobility lets you zip in the air and counter. Mount a companion dog for travel. Temporarily ride stunned monsters to fight others. 4-player co-op.

title: Guilty Gear -Strive-
why_it_hit: Rollback netcode, rock-music style, accessible-yet-deep.
mechanics: Punch/kick/slash/heavy slash/dust; Roman Cancel (freezes time to extend combos); wall break moves fight to new stage; burst; tension gauge.
design: 3D models rendered with limited animation frames to look hand-drawn.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D fighting game with 5 attack buttons and dash. Combos chain light→heavy; a "cancel meter" freezes time briefly to extend combos; pushing an opponent into a wall and hitting a big combo breaks the wall and moves the fight to a new stage area. Cel-shaded 3D characters with limited animation frames for an anime look.

title: Hitman 3
why_it_hit: Clockwork sandbox levels; creative, comedic assassinations.
mechanics: Disguises grant zone access; enforcers see through disguises; NPC routines; mission stories (guided opportunities); environmental kills; mastery unlocks starting locations; Silent Assassin rating.
build_prompt: Build an original stealth-sandbox infiltration game (reskin target to "steal the secret document" if you prefer non-violent). One big level, one target with a daily routine. Take disguises from knocked-out NPCs; each disguise allows certain zones; some NPCs recognise fakes. Environmental opportunities (spike a drink, drop a chandelier, sabotage a stage). Guided "story" hints for beginners. Score for being unseen.

title: Little Nightmares II
why_it_hit: Unsettling art direction, giant grotesque adults.
mechanics: Two children (AI companion) hold hands, boost each other; pick up objects as weapons; flashlights freeze enemies; chase sequences; light-and-sound stealth.
build_prompt: Build an original 2.5D side-scrolling horror puzzle game with two tiny children escaping a giant grotesque world. Hold hands, boost each other up ledges, sneak past huge adults, use a flashlight to freeze enemies, and drag a heavy hammer to break doors. No HUD; muted colours, deep shadows.

title: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
mechanics: Control the leader; order 4 AI teammates' abilities via a menu; "huddle" pep talk buffs based on dialogue choice; elemental blasters; constant banter; choices.
build_prompt: Build an original squad-based third-person action game: you control one hero and issue commands to 4 AI teammates with unique abilities (stun, lift, area damage, heavy hit). A "huddle" mechanic: mid-fight pep talk where picking the right line buffs the team. Constant banter, 80s rock-inspired ultimate.

title: Battlefield 2042
mechanics: 128 players on PC/next-gen; dynamic weather (tornadoes); specialists with gadgets (grapple, wingsuit, drone); Portal mode for custom rules.
build_prompt: Build an original large-scale military shooter: up to 64 vs 64 on huge maps with dynamic weather (tornadoes), land/air vehicles, destructible buildings, and class specialists with gadgets (wingsuit, grapple, recon drone). A rule editor lets players create custom modes.

title: Wordle
why_it_hit: One puzzle per day, same for everybody, spoiler-free emoji share grid.
mechanics: Guess 5-letter word in 6 tries; green = right letter right spot, yellow = in word wrong spot, grey = absent; hard mode; streak stats.
build_prompt: Build an original daily word-guessing web game in your own theme or language. Everyone gets the same hidden word each day (seeded by date). 6 guesses; colour feedback per letter (correct, present, absent) with flip animation; on-screen keyboard reflects letter states. Share button copies an emoji grid. Streak and win-distribution stats saved locally. Hard mode forces using revealed hints.

title: Poppy Playtime
why_it_hit: Mascot-horror took over YouTube and kids' culture.
mechanics: GrabPack with two extendable hands (grab far items, carry electricity between nodes, swing); chase sequences with a giant toy monster; VHS tapes for lore; chapters add hand types.
build_prompt: Build an original first-person horror puzzle game in an abandoned toy factory. Player wears a backpack with two extendable grabbing hands: grab far objects, carry electricity between nodes, swing across gaps. A huge friendly-looking mascot becomes a chase monster through vent tunnels. Collect VHS tapes for lore. Bright toy colours turned creepy by darkness.

title: Crab Game
why_it_hit: Free, viral, chaotic proximity chat.
mechanics: Rounds of playground games (red light/green light, hot potato tag, glass-bridge memory, king of the hill, dodgeball); eliminations each round; proximity voice; win money for cosmetics.
build_prompt: Build an original free 100-player first-person elimination game of playground games: red-light-green-light, hot potato tag, memory tile bridge, king of the hill, dodgeball. Each round eliminates players until one remains. Proximity voice chat; spectators watch.

title: Townscaper
why_it_hit: Instant beauty with zero skill; viral clips.
mechanics: Click to add a block on an irregular grid; algorithm turns blocks into walls, roofs, arches, stairs, gardens based on neighbours (wave function collapse); no goals.
build_prompt: Build an original relaxing toy-town builder on an irregular grid over water. Click to place a block of a chosen colour; the system auto-shapes it (walls, roofs, stairs, arches, gardens) based on neighbours using wave-function-collapse-style rules. No goals, just building. Soft pastels and gentle water sounds.

title: Knockout City
mechanics: 3v3; throw, catch with timing, fake throws, pass to charge, curve shots, roll into a ball (teammate throws you); special balls (bomb, moon, cage, sniper); glide.
build_prompt: Build an original team dodgeball brawler: 3v3, throw, catch with timing, fake throws, pass for speed, curve shots, roll into a ball and let teammates throw you. Special balls (bomb, low-gravity moon ball, cage ball that traps an enemy). Two hits knock a player out; first team to 10 KOs wins.

title: Age of Empires IV
mechanics: Villagers gather food/wood/gold/stone; age up by choosing 1 of 2 landmarks (different bonuses); 8+ asymmetric civilisations; unit counters (spear > cavalry > archers > spear); siege; documentaries.
build_prompt: Build an original historical RTS: villagers gather 4 resources; age up by building one of two landmark choices; 4 asymmetric civilisations; rock-paper-scissors counters (spear beats cavalry, cavalry beats archers, archers beat spear); siege weapons for walls; skirmish AI.

title: Dorfromantik
mechanics: Draw from a stack of hex tiles (forest, field, village, river, rail); matching edges = points; quests ask for groups of exact sizes; completing quests adds tiles; game ends when tiles run out.
build_prompt: Build an original relaxing hex-tile placement puzzle. Draw a stack of hex tiles with forests, fields, villages, rivers, railways. Matching edges scores points; perfect placements add bonus tiles; quest tiles ask for a group of exactly N forests etc. Completing quests adds tiles. Game ends when tiles run out. Soft watercolour pastels.

title: Cookie Run: Kingdom
mechanics: Build production buildings on timers (wood, jelly, sugar → goods); 5-character squad battles (front/middle/rear positions) with tapped skills; story chapters, arena, guild bosses; gacha for characters.
build_prompt: Build an original mobile hybrid: town-building + 5-character auto-battler squad RPG. Collect cute food-themed heroes; build production buildings that craft goods on timers; use squads in story battles where you tap each hero's skill when ready. Positions (front, middle, rear) matter.

title: Royal Match
mechanics: Swap adjacent tiles to match 3; 4 in line → rocket, 2×2 → propeller, L/T → bomb, 5 → light ball; combine power-ups; level goals; limited moves; stars renovate castle rooms.
build_prompt: Build an original match-3 puzzle: swap tiles to make lines of 3; 4 in line makes a rocket, 2×2 makes a propeller, L/T makes a bomb, 5 makes a colour-clearing orb; combining two power-ups makes mega effects. Level goals (break boxes, collect items) with limited moves. Stars earned renovate a castle area by area. Bright polished UI and satisfying combos.

title: Chivalry 2
mechanics: Directional attacks (slash, overhead, stab); parry, riposte, feint, kick; battle cries; throw anything; objective sieges (ram, burn village, escort cart); classes.
build_prompt: Build an original 64-player medieval melee game. Directional attacks (slash, overhead, stab), parry with riposte, feint, kick, battle cry. Objective-based sieges (push a ram, burn a village, escort a cart). Throw anything you pick up. Comedic chaos in a serious-looking castle siege.

title: Elden Ring
why_it_hit: Souls difficulty made approachable by freedom: stuck on a boss? go somewhere else, level up, come back.
core_loop: Explore → find dungeons/catacombs → beat bosses for runes → level stats → stronger gear → legacy dungeons → main bosses.
mechanics: Spirit horse with double jump; stealth; Spirit Ash summons; Ashes of War (swap weapon skills); stamina combat; guard counter; jump attacks; Sites of Grace checkpoints; runes lost on death (recover once); asynchronous messages and bloodstains from other players; co-op/invasions.
design: Minimal UI, golden Erdtree as landmark visible everywhere, dramatic reveals (view from cliffs), wildly varied bosses, melancholic fantasy.
build_prompt: Build an original open-world dark-fantasy action RPG. Large connected map with a giant glowing landmark visible from everywhere. Ride a spirit mount with double jump. Combat: light/heavy attacks, block, roll, jump attack, guard-counter, all costing stamina; swap special weapon skills between weapons. Summon spirit allies at boss fights. Dungeons hidden in caves and ruins each end in a mini-boss. Currency dropped on death, recoverable once. Checkpoints where you level up and respawn enemies. Players can leave short messages that others see. Bosses with multi-phase readable patterns.

title: Vampire Survivors
genre: Auto-attack horde survival roguelite (created the "survivors-like" genre)
why_it_hit: Only movement as input, power fantasy explodes in minutes, $3 price, bullet-heaven.
core_loop: Move → weapons fire automatically → kill hundreds of enemies → collect XP gems → level up → pick 1 of 3–4 weapons/passives → survive 30 minutes.
mechanics: 6 weapon slots + 6 passive slots; weapon evolution (max weapon + specific passive + chest at 10+ min = evolved weapon); treasure chests from elites; gold for permanent upgrades; unlockable characters with secret conditions; arcanas; reaper at 30 minutes.
design: Deliberately simple gothic pixel art, enormous screen-filling enemy counts, flashing number popups, chest-opening slot-machine animation, chiptune-orchestral music.
build_prompt: Build an original top-down horde survival roguelite. Player only moves (WASD/joystick); all weapons fire automatically on cooldowns. Enemies spawn in growing waves from off-screen toward the player, reaching 500+ on screen. Kills drop XP gems; level up offers 3 random choices of new weapon or upgrade. Max 6 weapons + 6 passives. Evolution: a max-level weapon + its paired passive + a boss chest = evolved super weapon. Elites drop chests with slot-machine reveal. Survive 20 minutes to win. Gold buys permanent stat upgrades and unlocks characters. Use simple pixel art, damage numbers, heavy screen flashes.

title: God of War Ragnarök
mechanics: Throwable axe that recalls; blades on chains; shield variants (parry vs block); companion arrows; nine realms hub; runic attacks; puzzles using the axe to freeze mechanisms.
design: One-shot continuous camera (no cuts), over-the-shoulder close combat, mythic landscapes.
build_prompt: Build an original third-person mythic action game. Main weapon is an axe that can be thrown and magically recalled (hits enemies on the way back), and freezes mechanisms when stuck in them for puzzles. Second weapon: chained blades for crowd control. Shield with parry timing. A companion fires arrows on command. Runic special attacks on cooldowns. Hub realms connected through a tree portal. Continuous camera with no cuts.

title: Horizon Forbidden West
mechanics: Robot dinosaurs with detachable parts; scanner (focus) to highlight weak spots; elemental arrows; tear off weapons from machines and use them; glider; underwater; override machines to ride.
build_prompt: Build an original open-world hunter game where wildlife are giant robotic animals. A scanner highlights components; shooting off a part (a cannon, a fuel tank) changes the fight and can be picked up and used. Elemental ammo (fire, frost, shock, acid) builds status meters. Hack machines to ride them. Climb with ledges, glide down. Lush post-apocalyptic nature reclaiming ruins.

title: Stray
why_it_hit: You're a cat. Knock things off tables, meow button, cats watching streams.
mechanics: Context jumps (button prompt to leap); meow button; robot city; drone companion translates; Zurk chase sequences; light-based enemy kill.
build_prompt: Build an original 3D adventure where you play a stray cat in a neon city inhabited only by robots. Movement: walk, context-jump to marked ledges, squeeze through gaps. Dedicated meow button; knock objects off shelves; scratch carpets; sleep on cushions (achievements). A small drone companion carries items and translates. Swarm creatures chase you in running sequences. Warm neon in rainy alleys.

title: Tunic
mechanics: In-game manual pages collected over time teach mechanics; unknown runic language; hidden paths behind camera angles; souls-like stamina combat.
build_prompt: Build an original isometric fox-hero adventure where the game's instruction manual is scattered as collectible pages written mostly in an invented script. Each page reveals secrets: hidden paths behind walls, a secret button combination, a map. Combat: sword, shield, roll, stamina. Tilt-shift diorama visuals.

title: Neon White
mechanics: Weapons are cards; each card can be fired OR discarded for a movement ability (double jump, dash, grapple, ground slam); collect demons in mini levels; leaderboards; hidden gifts.
build_prompt: Build an original first-person speedrun game in heaven-like stages. Weapons are cards picked up from the level; each card can be used as a gun OR discarded for a movement ability (pistol → double jump, rifle → dash, shotgun-like → ground slam, rocket → long jump). Kill every target, reach the goal fast. Medals for time; hidden presents unlock lore. Instant restart, ghost replay of best run.

title: Pokémon Legends: Arceus
why_it_hit: Finally let you catch creatures directly in the world, no battle needed.
mechanics: Catch creatures by throwing balls directly in world without battle; stealth sneaking; research tasks per species; alpha creatures.
build_prompt: Build an original creature-catching open-zone game: throw capture orbs directly at wild creatures without battle, better from behind or while they are distracted by food. Some creatures are aggressive. Research checklist per species (caught, seen using a move, fed) fills a dex. Big glowing "alpha" variants.

title: Pokémon Scarlet & Violet
why_it_hit: First fully open-world mainline entry; co-op exploration with friends.
mechanics: 3 parallel story paths (8 gyms, 5 giant "titan" creatures, 5 villain bases) in any order; Terastal (change a creature's type mid-battle with a crystal crown); 4-player co-op raids; auto-battle "Let's Go" mode; picnics and sandwich making for buffs; creature ride mount that unlocks swim/glide/climb.
build_prompt: Build an original open-world creature RPG with 3 parallel storylines you tackle in any order (8 arena challenges, 5 giant titan creatures, 5 rival-gang bases). Once per battle, crystallise a creature to change its type for surprise advantage. 4-player co-op raids against giant crystal bosses. Let creatures auto-battle weak wild ones. Your ride creature unlocks swim, glide and climb as story progresses. Picnics and sandwich crafting give spawn buffs.

title: Splatoon 3
why_it_hit: Unique "paint the floor" objective, fashion culture, Splatfest events.
mechanics: Turf War (most floor painted wins); swim fast in own ink (and refill ammo); enemy ink slows/damages; super jump to teammates; specials charged by painting; ranked modes; Salmon Run co-op horde; card game minigame.
build_prompt: Build an original 4v4 paint shooter: weapons spray paint; team with most floor area painted after 3 minutes wins. Players turn into a fast slick form to swim through their own colour to move and refill ammo; enemy colour slows them. Specials charged by painting (missile rain, big roller, shield). Co-op wave-defence mode vs fish-like enemies. Bright neon colours, urban skate-fashion style.

title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3
mechanics: 6-person party + guest hero; auto-attacks build arts; arts cancel combos; fusion arts; "Interlink" (two characters fuse into a giant form with heat gauge); class swapping between characters; chain attacks; huge landscapes on titans.
build_prompt: Build an original JRPG with real-time auto-attack combat for a 6-member party. Auto-attacks charge "arts" skills; using an art right after an auto-attack cancels for bonus. Two paired characters can fuse into a giant form for a limited heat gauge. Characters can learn other characters' classes. Chain-attack super move when gauge is full. Huge landscapes on the backs of colossal beings.

title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land
mechanics: Copy abilities by inhaling enemies (sword, fire, ice, bomb, drill…), upgradeable via blueprints; "Mouthful Mode" (stretch over a car, vending machine, traffic cone, stairs, light bulb); rescue creatures to grow a town hub with minigames; co-op.
build_prompt: Build an original 3D cute platformer where the round hero inhales enemies to copy their power, and can stretch around large objects ("mouthful" mode): become a car, a vending machine shooting cans, a traffic cone stabbing the floor, a light bulb lighting dark rooms. Rescue small creatures to grow a hub town with shops and minigames. Upgrade powers with blueprints.

title: Cult of the Lamb
why_it_hit: Cute-creepy aesthetic, two satisfying loops feeding each other.
mechanics: Dungeon "crusades" (rooms, random weapons/curses, bosses); base with followers needing food, sleep, cleanliness, faith; build farms, shrines, kitchens; sermons and rituals; doctrines (rules) with trade-offs; followers age, get sick, may dissent.
build_prompt: Build an original cute-creepy game alternating between: 1) top-down roguelite dungeon runs with random weapons and curses, rescuing followers, and 2) a base where followers need food, sleep, cleanliness and faith. Build farms, shrines, kitchens. Hold daily speeches for devotion, perform rituals, choose rules (doctrines) with trade-offs. Followers age, get sick and may rebel. Adorable cartoon style with dark humour.

title: Overwatch 2
mechanics: Roles (1 tank, 2 damage, 2 support); abilities + ultimate charged by damage/heal; modes: escort payload, control, push robot, flashpoint; role passives; hero swap mid-match to counter.
design: Pixar-like stylised heroes, readable silhouettes, voice-line ult callouts.
build_prompt: Build an original 5v5 hero shooter with roles: 1 tank, 2 damage, 2 support. Each hero has a primary weapon, 2 abilities and an ultimate charged by dealing damage/healing. Modes: escort a payload, capture zones, push a robot. Allow swapping heroes after death to counter enemies. Bright stylised art with distinctive silhouettes and voiced ultimate callouts.

title: Marvel Snap
why_it_hit: 3-minute matches; 12-card decks; Snap doubles bets like poker.
mechanics: 6 turns; 3 locations each with a random rule; win 2 of 3 locations by power; simultaneous turns; "snap" to double stakes; retreat to lose less; card variants and splits for collection.
build_prompt: Build an original 3-minute card game. Board: 3 locations revealed one per turn, each with a random effect ("cards here +2 power", "can't play here after turn 4"). Decks of 12 cards; 6 turns; energy = turn number. Both players play simultaneously, then cards reveal. Win by having more total power at 2 of 3 locations. Players can "bet double" anytime and retreat to limit losses. Cards upgrade cosmetically with fancy frames and 3D pop-out art.

title: Lost Ark
why_it_hit: Diablo-like combat at MMO scale; peaked 1.3M concurrent on Steam.
mechanics: 8 equipped skills with tripods (skill modifiers); counter attacks on flashing enemies; stagger and destruction meters; raids (Legion Raids) with mechanics; sailing between islands; card sets; life skills; engravings.
build_prompt: Build an original isometric action MMO: each class equips 8 skills, each with 3 modifier tiers (e.g., add fire, extend range). Bosses flash blue for a counter window; stagger bars break boss attacks. Raids with mechanics (stand in safe zones, split party). Sail a ship between islands each with a quest; collect card sets for passive bonuses.

title: Sifu
why_it_hit: Aging-on-death mechanic, choreographed fights inspired by kung-fu cinema.
mechanics: Death adds years (death counter increases the age added); older = stronger hits but less HP; after 70 the run ends; structure meter (break for takedowns); parry, dodge, avoid; environmental weapons; skill unlocks; shortcuts persist.
build_prompt: Build an original kung-fu brawler where death isn't game over — you age. Each death adds years (death counter increases the amount); older = stronger hits, less HP. Past 70, the run ends. Combat: punches, kicks, parry, dodge, structure meter (break it to do a takedown), throw objects, use bottles and sticks. Five levels each ending with a boss; shortcuts persist once found.

title: TMNT: Shredder's Revenge
why_it_hit: Perfect retro arcade revival with 6-player co-op.
mechanics: Light attack combos, dives, throws (toss enemies at the screen), super attacks from a "ninja power" meter filled by taunts/hits; revive allies; story mode with upgrades; arcade mode.
build_prompt: Build an original side-scrolling 6-player co-op beat 'em up with pixel-art heroes: combos, dash attacks, throws (hurl enemies into others or toward the screen), and super attacks from a power meter filled by taunting. Revive downed friends; character levels unlock moves; stages end with bosses.

title: Rollerdrome
mechanics: Perform tricks (grabs, flips, grinds) to refill ammo; "reflex time" slow-mo while airborne; dodge telegraphed attacks; arena challenges.
build_prompt: Build an original roller-skating action shooter in arenas: perform tricks (grabs, flips, grinds) to earn ammo; while airborne activate slow-motion to aim; dodge red-telegraphed enemy attacks; each arena has challenge goals. Cel-shaded 70s comic-book visuals.

title: Signalis
mechanics: 6-slot inventory; save rooms with item boxes; radio frequency tuning to solve puzzles; enemies revive unless burned; top-down 3D with PS1-style low-res.
build_prompt: Build an original sci-fi survival horror with a strict 6-slot inventory, save rooms with storage boxes, a radio you tune to frequencies to reveal secrets and solve puzzles, and enemies that get back up unless you burn them. Low-poly PS1 visuals mixed with anime portraits.

title: Pentiment
mechanics: Investigate a murder over years in a village; limited time per day — choose whom to visit; background choices affect dialogue options; fonts change by speaker's education; no right answer.
build_prompt: Build an original narrative mystery drawn like an illuminated manuscript. A crime occurs; you have a few days, each split into time blocks; choose whom to visit and what to investigate. Your character's background unlocks dialogue options. Each speaker's text uses a font matching their background. You must accuse someone without definitive proof; consequences across years.

title: A Plague Tale: Requiem
mechanics: Rat swarms of thousands avoid light; light/extinguish torches; slingshot with alchemical ammo (ignite, extinguish, attract rats); crafting; companion abilities; stealth or violence.
build_prompt: Build an original stealth adventure where swarms of thousands of rats flood areas but avoid light. Use a slingshot with alchemical ammo to ignite or extinguish fires, or lure rats onto guards. Escort a younger sibling with their own ability. Crafting benches upgrade gear.

title: Marvel's Midnight Suns
mechanics: 3 heroes per mission; each turn play 3 cards from combined hand; heroism resource; knockback into environmental objects; card redraws; friendship hub "Abbey" with relationships.
build_prompt: Build an original tactical card-based hero game: each turn play up to 3 ability cards from a shared hand of 3 heroes; attacks generate "heroism" spent on big moves and environmental attacks (throw a car, drop a lamp). Knockback into hazards. Between missions, a hub to build friendships that unlock combo abilities.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II
mechanics: 6v6 modes; ledge hang; dolphin dive; killstreaks; weapon platform tuning; DMZ extraction mode; ground war large maps.
build_prompt: Build an original modern military FPS: 6v6 modes (team deathmatch, domination, search & destroy), ledge-hanging, killstreaks (radar, airstrike, drone), and weapon tuning sliders (recoil vs aim speed). Include a PvE/PvP extraction mode.

title: Gran Turismo 7
mechanics: Café "menu books" as campaign (collect specific cars); license tests; tuning; dynamic weather/time; Sophy AI; scapes photo mode.
build_prompt: Build an original realistic racing game with a café-style campaign: each "menu" asks you to win 3 specific cars through races. License tests teach braking and cornering. Tuning shop, dynamic weather, and a photo mode.

title: Dwarf Fortress (Steam)
mechanics: Dig into a mountain, designate rooms, workshops; dwarves with needs, moods, relationships; procedural world history; sieges; tantrum spirals.
build_prompt: Build an original colony sim with dwarves: dig rooms into a mountain, assign workshops, manage food, drink, mood and relationships; procedurally generated world history; sieges by goblins; strange moods leading to artifacts.

title: Rogue Legacy 2
mechanics: On death pick an heir from 3 with random traits (positive/negative, comedic); gold spent on castle upgrades tree; heirlooms permanent abilities; biomes.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D roguelite castle crawler: on each death you choose 1 of 3 heirs with random classes and quirky traits (huge, tiny, colour-blind, pacifist with gold bonus). Gold is spent upgrading a manor skill tree. Permanent heirlooms (double jump, dash) unlock new areas.

title: Sonic Frontiers
mechanics: Open islands with floating rails, springs, boost pads; Cyloop (draw a circle to stun/reveal); cyberspace linear stages; titan boss fights.
build_prompt: Build an original open-zone speed platformer where rails, springs and boost pads float in open fields. Draw a light trail circle around enemies or objects to stun/reveal items. Portals to short linear speed stages. Giant boss fights with epic music.

title: Dome Keeper
mechanics: Mine down for iron/water/cobalt between waves; carry resources to dome; upgrade drill, jetpack, dome laser; waves arrive on timer.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D mining-defence game: mine underground for 3 resources between waves, carry them back up, then rush to the dome to aim lasers at monster waves. Upgrade drill speed, carrying capacity, dome weapons. Pixel art with a clear wave countdown.

title: Brotato
mechanics: 20 waves of 20–90s; up to 6 weapons; shop between waves (lock items, reroll); character-specific rules (one-armed, lucky, crazy); materials as XP + currency.
build_prompt: Build an original arena survivors-like: a potato hero holds up to 6 weapons that fire automatically. 20 short waves; between waves, a shop with reroll and lock. Materials dropped by enemies are both XP and currency. Characters with strange rules (only one weapon, double luck, no healing).

title: MultiVersus
mechanics: Damage % raises knockback; ring-outs score; 2v2 team focus with support moves (tethers, shields, buffs); perks chosen before matches; crossover roster; dodges and air attacks.
build_prompt: Build an original 2v2 platform fighter where damage % builds up and knockback grows; knock opponents off the stage edges. Heroes have team-support moves (tether allies, shield buffs). Perks equip before matches.

title: Goddess of Victory: NIKKE
mechanics: Squad of 5 behind cover; tap/drag to aim; release to shoot; burst chain (Burst I → II → III) for a "full burst" damage window.
build_prompt: Build an original mobile rear-view cover shooter: squad of 5 characters, drag to aim, release to take cover/reload, burst skills chained in 3 stages for a damage window.

title: Eggy Party
mechanics: Egg avatars race, survive, team games; huge user-generated level editor.
build_prompt: Build an original mobile party game with egg-shaped avatars (race, survival and team modes) and a level editor so players create and share obstacle courses.

title: PowerWash Simulator
why_it_hit: Pure satisfaction: dirt goes away, numbers go to 100%.
mechanics: Nozzles (0°, 15°, 25°, 40°); soaps per grime type; each part pings when clean; percentage per object; upgrade washer; co-op.
build_prompt: Build an original cleaning sim: a dirty object/scene (car, skatepark, house) covered in grime layers. Spray water with nozzle widths; dirt removes in real time (texture mask). Each part chimes and flashes when 100% clean. Different soaps for different grime. Earn money for better washers. Calm ambient audio.

title: Chained Echoes
mechanics: Overdrive bar: keep it in green zone for bonus by using the highlighted skill type; too much = overheat; mech (Sky Armor) battles; no XP grinding (gear and skill points).
build_prompt: Build an original 16-bit style JRPG with an "Overdrive" bar: actions push it up; using the highlighted skill type cools it into the green zone for bonus damage/defense; overheating makes you vulnerable. Mech battles on airships. No random encounters; full HP after each fight.

title: Slime Rancher 2
mechanics: Vacuum-gun sucks up slimes, food, plorts; feed slimes to get plorts (sell at fluctuating market); combine two slime types into largos; corrals, coops, gardens; explore islands.
build_prompt: Build an original first-person ranch game: a vacuum gun sucks up cute slimes and shoots them into pens. Feed slimes to produce crystal "plorts" to sell at a fluctuating market. Feed a slime another type's plort to make a hybrid. Build pens, gardens, coops on your ranch; explore islands to find new slime types.

title: Baldur's Gate 3
why_it_hit: Tabletop freedom in a video game — almost any idea works; deep companions; huge reactivity.
core_loop: Explore → talk (dialogue with dice skill checks) → fight in turn-based combat → long rest at camp (companion scenes) → level up → choices change story.
mechanics: D20 skill checks with visible dice roll; advantage/disadvantage; action + bonus action + movement per turn; height advantage; shove; surfaces (oil + fire, water + lightning); stealth; 12 classes, multiclassing; spell slots; romance; consequences tracked for whole game.
design: Cinematic dialogue cameras, full voice acting, tactical top-down camera for combat, rich colour per region.
build_prompt: Build an original fantasy turn-based tactics RPG with a party of 4. Each turn a unit has 1 action, 1 bonus action and movement. Combat uses dice: attack rolls vs armour class, show a d20 animation. High ground gives +2 to hit; shoving enemies off ledges; environmental surfaces (oil ignites, water conducts lightning, ice makes slip). Dialogue with skill checks (persuade, intimidate, insight) showing the rolled dice. Camp at night restores spells and unlocks companion conversations and relationships. Choices (spare or kill a character) are remembered and change later chapters.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
