why_it_hit: Players build vehicles, machines, absurd contraptions — infinite creativity.
mechanics: Ultrahand (glue objects together into vehicles); Fuse (attach any item to weapons/arrows); Ascend (swim up through ceilings); Recall (rewind an object's time); Zonai devices (fans, wheels, rockets, batteries); sky islands, surface, underground depths layers.
design: Painterly cel-shading, three vertical map layers, shrines as bite-sized puzzles.
build_prompt: Build an original physics sandbox adventure. The hero has 4 powers: grab-and-glue any object to any other to build contraptions; attach any item to a weapon or arrow to create combos (rock + stick = hammer, fire fruit + arrow = fire arrow); pass upward through any ceiling; rewind an object's movement in time. Powered parts (fan, wheel, rocket, balloon, steering stick) need battery energy. World has 3 layers: floating sky islands, ground, dark underground. 40 puzzle shrines each built around one mechanic.

title: Hogwarts Legacy
mechanics: Spell loadouts with combo colours; broom flight; Room of Requirement customisation; beast caretaking; classes unlock spells; puzzles.
build_prompt: Build an original open-world magic-academy RPG. Attend classes to learn spells, each colour-coded (control, force, damage). Combat combos: lift enemy, pull, then blast. Fly a broom across valleys. A personal room that you decorate and use to raise magical creatures. Hidden puzzles using spells (light braziers, move blocks).

title: Lethal Company
why_it_hit: Cheap indie, proximity voice chat makes scary moments hilarious.
mechanics: Quota every 3 days; fly to moons; collect scrap inside facilities; one player can stay on the ship monitoring a radar map and opening doors; monsters with unique behaviours (don't look at it / stops when watched); weather; buy tools (flashlight, shovel, walkie).
build_prompt: Build an original co-op horror salvage game. A company sets a profit quota every 3 in-game days. Crew flies to dangerous moons, enters dark facilities and carries out scrap (heavy items slow you). One player can stay on the ship to watch a radar map, open locked doors remotely and guide others over walkie-talkie. Monsters each have a rule (freezes when looked at; follows sound; hides in vents). Proximity voice chat. Buy tools between days. If the quota fails, everyone is fired (game over).

title: Starfield
why_it_hit: Massive hype; ship building became the community's favourite feature.
mechanics: 1000+ procedurally generated planets with landing zones; modular ship builder (cockpit, reactor, engines, habs, weapons snap together) affecting mass and mobility; outposts with resource extractors; factions questlines; boost-pack low-gravity combat; persuasion minigame; NG+ twist.
build_prompt: Build an original space RPG: fly between star systems, land on procedural planets to scan flora/fauna and mine resources. Snap-together ship editor (cockpit, reactor, engines, cargo, weapons) where mass affects speed and turning. Build outposts with extractors linked by cargo routes. Faction questlines. Boost-pack jumps in low gravity; ship dogfights with power routing.

title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
mechanics: Swap between two heroes instantly in the open world; web wings to glide; slingshot launch; parry system; dark symbiote powers that tendril through crowds; bigger city with two boroughs.
build_prompt: Build an original two-hero swinging game: switch between heroes instantly anywhere. Web-wings let you glide between rooftops and ride wind tunnels. Combat adds a parry (red flash = parry, yellow = dodge). One hero gains dark symbiotic powers that whip and spread through groups of enemies.

title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
why_it_hit: First new 2D entry in a decade; every level has a surprise.
mechanics: Wonder Flower transforms each level wildly (pipes become worms, perspective change, musical numbers); talking flowers; badges (pick one perk); elephant power-up; online ghosts and standees.
design: Highly expressive animation, bright toy-like colours.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D side-scrolling platformer where each level hides a "wonder seed" that, when touched, transforms the level for 30 seconds into something surreal (pipes wiggle like worms, the camera goes top-down, enemies sing). Equip one badge per level (wall climb, float jump, invisible). Talking flowers comment on your actions. Bright toy-like visuals with expressive animation.

title: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon
mechanics: Assemble mechs from parts (head, core, arms, legs — bipedal, reverse-joint, tank, tetrapod — boosters, generator, 4 weapon slots); weight/energy limits; quick-boost and assault boost; ACS stagger bar; mission rankings; Arena duels.
build_prompt: Build an original mech action game. Assemble a mech from parts: head, core, arms, 4 leg types, booster, generator, 2 arm + 2 shoulder weapons; weight vs load limit, energy vs generator. Fast boost dashes cost energy. Hitting enemies fills their stagger bar; staggered enemies take huge damage. Mission briefings, rankings, and a 1v1 arena ladder.

title: Lies of P
mechanics: Weapon assembly (separate blade and handle with different scaling/movesets); perfect guard (parry) that breaks enemy weapons; Legion Arm gadgets (grapple, flamethrower, shield); P-organ upgrades; lying in dialogue affects humanity and ending.
build_prompt: Build an original souls-like in a gothic Belle-Époque city overrun by puppets. Weapons are assembled from a blade + a handle (combine for unique movesets). Perfect parry breaks enemy weapons over time. A mechanical arm slot gives gadgets (grapple, flamethrower, shield). Dialogue choices to lie or tell truth change the protagonist and the ending.

title: Alan Wake 2
mechanics: Two protagonists; detective's "Mind Place" board to pin clues and deduce; writer's "Plot Board" rewrites scenes to change the environment; flashlight burns darkness shields off enemies; limited ammo; live-action video segments.
build_prompt: Build an original psychological horror game with two playable characters. The detective has a "mind board" where you drag collected clues onto case threads to make deductions that unlock progress. The writer can rewrite a scene by choosing plot elements, transforming the room. Enemies are shielded by darkness until you burn it off with a flashlight beam, then shoot.

title: Hi-Fi Rush
why_it_hit: Shadow-dropped surprise; everything grooves to the music.
mechanics: The whole world moves to the beat; attacks on beat deal more damage; parry sequences match music; partners called in on beat; combo ranks.
build_prompt: Build an original rhythm-action brawler where everything (environment, enemies, platforms) moves to the music beat. Attacks timed on beat deal extra damage and extend combos; an on-screen pulse or a metronome pet helps. Boss parry battles where you parry in rhythm. Call partner attacks on the beat. Cel-shaded cartoon look.

title: Dave the Diver
why_it_hit: Two loops that feed each other plus endless surprise minigames.
mechanics: Day: dive into a changing blue hole, harpoon fish, oxygen = HP, weight limit; Night: run a sushi restaurant, serve customers, set menu, hire staff; dozens of mini-games.
build_prompt: Build an original pixel-art 2-part game. Day: dive into a changing ocean hole, catch fish with a harpoon, net or gun; oxygen meter doubles as health; carry weight limit; depth zones with bigger fish and sharks. Night: manage a sushi restaurant, choose menu from your catch, serve dishes by tapping in time, keep tea cups full, hire staff. Money upgrades both sides.

title: Sea of Stars
mechanics: Timed hits and blocks; enemy cast "locks" with symbols you must break with matching damage types before the cast completes; combo moves between two heroes; live mana orbs absorbed to boost attacks; free movement (climb, swim, jump); cooking.
build_prompt: Build an original retro turn-based JRPG: timed hits (press on impact for bonus) and timed blocks. When enemies charge a spell, a row of "lock" icons appears (sun, moon, sword, blunt); break all locks with matching attacks before it completes to cancel it. Combo moves between two heroes. Free movement exploration with climbing and swimming. Pixel art with dynamic lighting.

title: Dredge
mechanics: Fishing minigames per fish type; Tetris-like hold inventory; day/night: panic meter rises at night causing hallucinations and monster attacks; aberrant mutated fish; boat upgrades (engines, lights, nets); research.
build_prompt: Build an original fishing horror: by day, fish with timing minigames that differ by species; arrange catches in a Tetris-shaped cargo grid; sell at ports. At night, fog and a panic meter rise, causing hallucinations, rocks that appear from nowhere, and sea monsters. Catch rare mutated fish. Upgrade engine, lights and hull.

title: Cocoon
mechanics: Worlds exist inside orbs; carry an orb, jump into it to enter its world; carry orbs inside other worlds (nested recursion); each orb grants a power (shoot, reveal paths).
build_prompt: Build an original puzzle adventure where whole worlds exist inside orbs you can carry. Jump into an orb to enter its world; carry other orbs inside. Each orb gives a power when held (fire a beam, reveal hidden bridges, float). Puzzles require nesting worlds within worlds. Alien bug-like atmosphere, no text.

title: Pizza Tower
mechanics: Mach run (builds speed in 3 tiers); combo meter that decays; transformations; points ranking (P-rank); "Pizza Time" escape back to the start under a timer after reaching the end.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D high-speed cartoon platformer: hold run to accelerate through 3 mach-speed tiers; crash through blocks and enemies; keep a combo meter alive by hitting things. At the end of each level, a timer starts and you must race back to the beginning through altered routes. Ranks D to P. Frantic 90s cartoon art.

title: Street Fighter 6
mechanics: Drive Gauge (6 bars): Drive Parry, Drive Rush, Drive Impact (armoured), Drive Reversal; Burnout when empty; Modern controls (one-button specials); World Tour open-world RPG mode; Battle Hub lobby.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D fighting game with a 6-bar drive meter used for parry, dash-cancel, an armoured strike, and a reversal; empty meter = burnout (vulnerable). Classic 6-button controls and a simplified mode where one button + direction does specials. Add an avatar story mode.

title: Mortal Kombat 1
mechanics: Kameo assist fighters callable mid-combo; Invasions board-game mode; fatalities.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D fighter where each player selects a main fighter plus an assist partner who can be called mid-combo for extensions, throws or escapes. A board-game style single-player mode with nodes, buffs and bosses.

title: Diablo IV
mechanics: Open-world regions; loot rarities with affixes; skill tree; Legendary aspects extracted and imprinted; dungeons, Helltides, world bosses; seasons; paragon boards.
build_prompt: Build an original dark isometric action RPG: loot with rarity colours and random affixes; skill tree with 6 active slots; legendary powers extracted from items and imprinted onto others; open-world events, dungeons, world bosses; endgame grid of paragon boards.

title: Honkai: Star Rail
mechanics: 4-character party; shared skill point pool (basic attack +1, skill −1); toughness bar broken by weakness element → delay + break effect; ultimates usable any time when charged (even on enemy turn); speed-based turn order; Simulated Universe roguelike mode.
build_prompt: Build an original space-train turn-based RPG: 4 characters share a skill-point pool (basic attack adds 1, skill costs 1). Enemies have a toughness bar broken only by their weak elements, delaying them. Ultimates can be fired at any moment once charged. Turn order by speed shown on a timeline. Roguelike mode with random blessings.

title: Counter-Strike 2
mechanics: Bomb defusal; economy; precise recoil spray patterns; volumetric smoke grenades that fill spaces and can be cleared by HE grenades/bullets; sub-tick networking; Premier ranking.
build_prompt: Build an original tactical 5v5 bomb-defuse shooter with a round economy, learnable recoil patterns and volumetric smoke grenades that fill rooms realistically, flow around corners, and are temporarily pushed open by explosions and bullets.

title: Final Fantasy XVI
mechanics: Real-time action combat; equip 3 summon-power sets (each 2 abilities + feat); "Eikon" kaiju battles as cinematic set pieces; stagger; precision dodge.
build_prompt: Build an original action RPG with real-time sword-and-magic combat: equip 3 elemental power sets and swap instantly, each with 2 cooldown abilities. Precision dodge triggers counters. Story climaxes are giant monster-versus-monster cinematic battles.

title: Resident Evil 4 (Remake)
mechanics: Knife parry (durability); melee follow-ups on staggered enemies; grid attaché case inventory; merchant upgrades and requests; escort a companion; crafting ammo.
build_prompt: Build an original third-person action horror set in a hostile rural village. Shoot enemies' legs/heads to stagger, then do melee follow-ups. A knife can parry attacks but has durability. Grid inventory case. A merchant sells upgrades and gives side requests. Escort and protect a companion.

title: Star Wars Jedi: Survivor
mechanics: 5 stances (single, double, dual, blaster, crossguard); force powers (push, pull, slow); metroidvania planets; meditation checkpoints; mounts; parry timing.
build_prompt: Build an original souls-lite energy-sword adventure with 5 combat stances (fast single, spinning double, dual-wield, sword+pistol, heavy crossguard), telekinetic powers (push, pull, slow time), metroidvania planets with traversal unlocks, and rest checkpoints that respawn enemies.

title: Remnant II
mechanics: Procedurally assembled worlds and storylines per campaign; archetypes (Medic, Hunter, Handler with dog…) dual-classable; mods on guns; bosses with gimmicks.
build_prompt: Build an original 3-player co-op third-person shooter souls-like where each campaign rolls different worlds, dungeons, bosses and story variations. Two archetype classes per character (healer, hunter, summoner, engineer). Weapon mods with cooldown powers.

title: Party Animals
mechanics: Fluffy animals; grab, punch, kick, headbutt, throw; ragdoll knockouts; drop enemies off maps; football and team modes.
build_prompt: Build an original physics brawler with fluffy cartoon animals: grab, punch, dropkick, throw opponents off maps or into hazards. Knocked-out characters go limp and can be carried. Up to 8 players, team modes and silly weapons.

title: Cities: Skylines II
mechanics: Zoning (residential/commercial/industrial/office); road tools; traffic AI; service coverage; economy, taxes; milestones unlocking features; seasons.
build_prompt: Build an original city-builder: draw roads, zone residential/commercial/industrial; buildings grow based on demand bars. Place services (power, water, police, fire, schools) with coverage radius. Traffic simulation with agents. Budget and taxes; milestones unlock features.

title: Viewfinder
mechanics: Take photos or hold pictures up and place them into the world — they become real 3D geometry; copy and paste spaces.
build_prompt: Build an original first-person perspective puzzle game: hold up a photo or drawing and place it into the world; whatever's in the picture becomes real 3D geometry in that spot (bridges, stairs, batteries). Use a camera to capture parts of the world and paste them elsewhere.

title: Pikmin 4
mechanics: Pluck and throw small plant creatures; colour types (fire immunity, electricity, swim, weight); carry treasures to base; day timer; Oatchi dog companion; night defence missions.
build_prompt: Build an original creature-command strategy game: pluck small plant creatures from the ground, throw them at objects and enemies; they carry treasures back to your ship. Colour types are immune to hazards (fire, electricity, water). Day timer forces returning before night. Dog companion that carries a group.

title: THE FINALS
mechanics: Fully destructible arenas; 3 body types (light/medium/heavy) with gadgets; cash-out objective (carry vaults to cash stations); team wipes and revives as statues.
build_prompt: Build an original team game-show shooter with fully destructible arenas. 3 body types: light (fast, invisibility), medium (healing beam), heavy (shield, sledgehammer). Steal vault boxes and deposit them at cash-out stations, defend while the timer runs. Announcer commentary.

title: Sons of the Forest
mechanics: Free-form log building (cut logs, place them); mutants and tribes with behaviour; AI companion (follows commands, gathers); caves with key items; seasons.
build_prompt: Build an original island survival horror: cut trees into logs and place them freely to build cabins; hostile tribes observe and attack based on your behaviour; an AI companion you can command to gather wood or fight; caves with gear; snowy winters.

title: Monopoly GO!
mechanics: Roll dice to move; land on properties for coins; build landmarks to finish boards; shutdown/heist minigames vs friends; sticker albums; dice multiplier; constant events.
build_prompt: Build an original mobile dice board game: roll dice to move around a board, earn coins, build 5 landmarks to complete each themed board, attack and raid friends' boards in minigames, collect sticker albums, and use a dice multiplier for risk/reward.

title: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk
mechanics: Skates, BMX, skateboard; grinds, manuals, boosts; tag graffiti with gesture patterns; crew battles (score), police heat chases.
build_prompt: Build an original trick-movement game: switch between skates, bike and board; chain grinds, wall-rides and tricks for score and boost meter; spray graffiti by drawing a gesture pattern; crew score battles; police chases when you cause trouble. Cel-shaded Y2K funk style.

title: The Talos Principle 2
mechanics: Laser connectors (route coloured beams), jammers, gravity tools, driller, inverter; hub city with philosophical conversations.
build_prompt: Build an original first-person puzzle game: carry connector devices to route coloured light beams to receivers, use jammers to disable force fields, invert colours and swap positions. A hub city with philosophical dialogues between puzzle sets.

title: Suika Game (Watermelon Game)
mechanics: Drop fruits into a box; two identical fruits merge into the next bigger one; physics; game over if box overflows.
build_prompt: Build an original physics merge puzzle. Drop items (start with 5 random small tiers) from the top into a container. Two of the same tier touching merge into the next larger tier (11 tiers). Score on merges. If anything stays above the top line for 2 seconds, game over. Cute round faces on each tier, satisfying pop sounds, next-item preview.

title: Only Up!
mechanics: One enormous vertical path of random objects into the sky; jump/climb; no checkpoints (one fall can lose hours).
build_prompt: Build an original vertical climbing rage game: a single huge tower of random everyday objects floating into the sky (pipes, cranes, cars, giant furniture). Run, jump, climb ledges; no checkpoints; height meter on screen and personal best line.

title: Palworld
why_it_hit: "Creature collector with guns" — 8M copies in 6 days; creatures work your base.
mechanics: Catch creatures with thrown spheres (chance %); creatures have work skills (kindling, watering, mining, handiwork) and automate the base; ride/fly mounts; creature partner skills; tech tree unlocked by level points; hunger, temperature, raids; breeding for passives.
design: Bright, cute monster designs in a realistic open world; base management with visible workers.
build_prompt: Build an original open-world survival crafting game with collectible creatures. Weaken creatures and throw capture orbs (show capture %). Each creature has work traits (fire, water, mining, crafting, transport, planting) with levels; assign them to your base where they automatically work stations (furnace, farm, workbench). Creatures can be ridden, used in combat, or bred to combine passive traits. Player has hunger and temperature, a tech tree unlocked with level points, and bases get raided.

title: Helldivers 2
why_it_hit: Friendly fire chaos, comedic propaganda tone, community-wide galactic war.
mechanics: Stratagems called by typing arrow-key codes then throwing a beacon (airstrikes, turrets, mechs, resupply); friendly fire always on; reinforcement drops; extraction under pressure; global war map where all players' missions liberate planets; dev "game master" events.
design: Satirical militaristic UI, big explosions, ragdoll.
build_prompt: Build an original 4-player co-op shooter on hostile planets. Players call in support by entering a 4–6 arrow-key code, then throwing a beacon: orbital strike, airstrike, sentry turret, supply pod, mech suit, reinforcements. Friendly fire is always on. Missions: complete objectives, then hold out at extraction for 2 minutes. Bug and robot factions. A shared "galactic war" map shows community progress liberating planets. Satirical heroic propaganda UI.

title: Black Myth: Wukong
mechanics: Staff stances (smash, pillar, thrust); focus points build from light attacks to fuel heavy attacks; spells (immobilise, clone); transformations into defeated bosses; gourd healing; 80+ bosses.
build_prompt: Build an original mythic action RPG with a staff-wielding monkey-warrior hero (your own design). Light attacks build focus points; heavy attacks spend them for big hits. 3 staff stances. Spells: freeze an enemy in place, create clones, transform into a defeated boss form for a limited time. Drink from a gourd to heal (limited sips). Dozens of distinct bosses in painterly ancient landscapes.

title: Balatro
why_it_hit: Simple poker hands + absurd multiplier combos; 1 dev; "one more run".
mechanics: Play poker hands to reach a score target (chips × mult); limited hands and discards per blind; Jokers (up to 5) with passive effects (+mult for each heart, ×3 if hand contains a pair); shop between blinds; Tarot cards modify cards; Planet cards level poker hands; boss blinds with restrictions; 8 antes.
design: CRT shader, psychedelic swirling background, satisfying number tick-ups and card juice.
build_prompt: Build an original card roguelike based on poker hands. Each round has a score target. Play up to 5 cards; score = (base chips of hand + card values) × multiplier. 4 hands and 3 discards per round. Between rounds, a shop sells passive "trick cards" (max 5 slots) that modify scoring (+4 mult per diamond; ×2 mult if hand has 3 cards; earn $ per face card), consumables that change cards' suits/ranks or upgrade hand types. Every third round is a boss with a rule (all spades debuffed). 8 antes to win. CRT filter, swirling background, numbers that pop and shake.

title: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
why_it_hit: Huge open regions, beloved characters, and one of the best card minigames ever made.
mechanics: Hybrid real-time/ATB combat; synergy skills and synergy abilities between party pairs; region exploration with towers, chocobo variants (glide, climb); "Queen's Blood" card minigame (3×5 lanes, cards claim tiles, rank = cost, row with higher power wins points); relationship (affinity) system.
build_prompt: Build an original action-RPG with paired "synergy" attacks between two party members that charge over time, plus a built-in collectible card minigame: a 3×5 board, each card has a rank (1–3 pips) and a pattern that claims adjacent tiles; you can only place on tiles you own with enough pips; each row's higher total power wins that row's points. Mounts that glide and climb unlock regions.

title: Dragon's Dogma 2
why_it_hit: Emergent chaos: griffins carry people off, pawns share knowledge, physics-heavy fights.
mechanics: Pawns (AI companions); your main pawn is shared online and returns with knowledge; vocations (classes) switchable; climb giant monsters and stab weak spots; slow travel via ox-carts; camping; curse (dragonsplague) spreading through pawns.
build_prompt: Build an original fantasy action RPG where your party is 3 AI companions that learn from what they see; one is your custom companion, shared with other players, who comes back with knowledge (routes, monster weaknesses). Players climb onto giant monsters to stab weak spots. Travel is slow and dangerous: ox-carts, campfires at night, monsters ambush the road.

title: Stellar Blade
mechanics: Parry-focused combat (perfect parry builds "Beta" energy); Beta skills and Burst skills; blink/repulse counters for blue/purple attacks; exospine perks; post-apocalyptic city hub; camps as checkpoints.
build_prompt: Build an original stylish action game: block, perfect parry and perfect dodge are central. Perfect parries fill an energy bar for special skills; certain colour-coded enemy attacks need a specific counter (teleport behind for blue, push back for purple). Upgrade skill trees and perks. Post-apocalyptic city hub with side quests.

title: Astro Bot
why_it_hit: Pure joy; every level has a new power-up gimmick; rescue cameo bots.
mechanics: Hover jump, spin attack; level power-ups (dog-rocket backpack, sponge that swells with water, time-stop watch, balloon inflation, mouse shrink); rescue hidden bots that populate a crash-site hub.
build_prompt: Build an original joyful 3D platformer with a tiny robot hero. Every level has its own power-up: a jetpack dog, a sponge suit that absorbs water and swells, a stopwatch that freezes time, a shrinking mouse form, a balloon that inflates. Rescue 10 hidden bots per level; they appear in a hub that grows. Everything breakable gives coins and satisfying particles. Bright toybox palette.

title: Animal Well
why_it_hit: Layers of secrets that took the whole internet weeks to crack.
mechanics: No combat weapon; tools (bubble wand making platforms, frisbee, yo-yo, slinky, firecrackers) with surprising uses; secret bunnies, eggs, and community-wide puzzles.
build_prompt: Build an original dark pixel-art puzzle metroidvania. The blob hero has no attack; instead finds tools with multiple uses: a bubble wand (blow bubbles to stand on), a frisbee (distract animals, ride it), firecrackers (scare ghosts), a yo-yo (press buttons remotely). Hidden collectible eggs and secret rooms layered deep. Bioluminescent glow effects.

title: UFO 50
why_it_hit: 50 complete, inventive "lost console" games with a hidden meta-story.
mechanics: Each game a different genre (platformer, golf, RPG, strategy, shmup, racing…) with strict 32-colour palette and 8-bit limits; gift/cherry/gold achievements per game; fake company history connects them.
build_prompt: Build an original collection of tiny retro "8-bit" games (start with 6: a platformer, a top-down shooter, a puzzle game, a golf game, a mini-RPG, a racing game) presented as a fictional 1980s console library with a shared palette, fake box art, a launcher menu, and per-game achievements.

title: Satisfactory
mechanics: Miners on nodes; belts and splitters; smelters → constructors → assemblers → manufacturers; foundations; power grid (biomass → coal → fuel → nuclear); trains, trucks, drones; milestones via space elevator; alternate recipes from hard drives.
build_prompt: Build an original first-person factory builder on an alien planet: place miners on ore nodes, smelters and constructors connected by conveyor belts; build foundations for multi-level factories; power grid that evolves from burners to nuclear; deliver parts to a space elevator to unlock new tiers; trains and drones for logistics.

title: Manor Lords
why_it_hit: 1 developer; organic (no-grid) beautiful towns; top Steam wishlist.
mechanics: Organic roads and burgage plots with backyard extensions; families assigned to workplaces; seasons and crop rotation; trade posts; approval; regional claims; tactical battles with formations.
build_prompt: Build an original medieval town builder without grids: draw organic roads and housing plots that auto-subdivide; families take jobs at buildings; seasons affect farming and firewood needs; trade routes; approval affects growth; small tactical battles with unit formations.

title: Enshrouded
mechanics: Deadly "Shroud" fog in lowlands with a timer while inside; flame altars as bases that expand radius when upgraded; rescue NPC craftsmen; glider; voxel terrain deformation; skill tree with classes.
build_prompt: Build an original voxel survival RPG where a deadly fog covers the lowlands (a countdown timer while inside). Light flame altars to create safe bases; upgrading the flame expands buildable area and fog time. Rescue NPC craftsmen who set up stations. Glide off cliffs. Dig and reshape terrain.

title: Content Warning
why_it_hit: Free for 24 hours at launch → 6M players; funny streamer content.
mechanics: Descend into "Old World" with a camera; limited film; monsters; return and upload the footage; views based on scares and moments; views = money; sponsorships; emote items for funny footage.
build_prompt: Build an original co-op horror comedy: friends descend into a dark underground place with one camera and limited film to capture scary monsters and funny moments. Back on the surface, the clip is "uploaded" and gets views based on how scary and interesting it was. Views = money for better cameras, lights and emote items.

title: Buckshot Roulette
mechanics: Shotgun loaded with a revealed number of live/blank shells in hidden order; shoot dealer or self (blank on self = extra turn); items: magnifier (peek), beer (eject), handcuffs (skip opponent turn), saw (double damage), cigarettes (heal).
build_prompt: Build an original tense turn-based duel in a grimy room vs a creepy dealer (use a non-weapon reskin like a "shock button" if you want it kid-friendly). Each round the device is loaded with a shown count of live and blank charges in random order. On your turn target the dealer or yourself (blank on self gives another turn). Items: peek next charge, eject a charge, skip opponent's turn, double damage, heal. Limited lives as glowing charges.

title: Pacific Drive
mechanics: Your station wagon is the base and the lifeline; drive into anomaly zones; repair panels, tyres, doors; craft upgrades at the garage; anomalies (electric, gravity); escape when storm closes.
build_prompt: Build an original survival driving game: an old station wagon is your only shelter. Drive into an anomaly zone, scavenge parts, repair individual car parts (doors, tyres, battery, lights), and escape through a gateway before a storm closes in. Back at the garage, craft upgrades. Anomalies: lightning ghosts, gravity pullers, mannequins that grab the car.

title: Metaphor: ReFantazio
mechanics: Calendar of days with deadlines; social bonds (followers) unlock Archetypes (classes) with inheritable skills; field combat (hit weak enemies in real time) transitions to turn-based "Press Turn" battles; election popularity; dungeon exploration.
build_prompt: Build an original fantasy JRPG with a calendar: each day you choose activities (raise virtues, bond with allies, explore dungeons) before a deadline. Bonds unlock classes; skills can be inherited between classes. Weak enemies can be defeated in the field in real time; stronger ones start turn-based battles where exploiting weakness gives extra turns.

title: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown
mechanics: Time powers: Shadow of the Wind (leave a marker, teleport back), dash, Clairvoyance; parries (yellow) and unblockables (red); "memory shards" (screenshots pinned to map); amulets.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D action metroidvania with time powers: leave a shadow marker and teleport back to it, air dash, reveal hidden platforms. Precise parries (yellow flash) vs dodges (red flash). Pin screenshot "memory shards" onto the map to remember unsolved spots. Amulet perks.

title: Tekken 8
mechanics: Heat system (activate once per round for chip damage, extended combos, heat smash); recoverable health; special style simplified controls; Arcade Quest mode.
build_prompt: Build an original 3D fighter with sidestep movement and a once-per-round "heat" mode that powers up for ~10 seconds (chip damage on block, new moves, a finisher). Damage taken can be partially recovered by attacking. Simplified controls option.

title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
mechanics: Whip (swing, disarm, pull); disguises for restricted areas; improvised melee (shovels, pans, guitars); stealth; camera photography; puzzle tombs; adventure book journal.
build_prompt: Build an original first-person archaeology adventure: a whip for swinging across gaps, disarming and pulling enemies; disguises let you walk into restricted zones; improvised melee with everyday objects; camera to photograph clues; tomb puzzles with light, mirrors, and moving statues; journal of notes and maps.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6
mechanics: Omnimovement (sprint, slide and dive in any direction, supine aiming); Zombies round-based co-op; heist-themed campaign.
build_prompt: Build an original FPS with omnidirectional movement: sprint, slide and dive in any direction; lie on your back and aim. Include a round-based co-op undead survival mode with buyable doors, wall weapons and perk machines.

title: Marvel Rivals
why_it_hit: 10M players in 72 hours; superhero roster, team-ups, destruction.
mechanics: Vanguard/Duelist/Strategist roles; team-up abilities (certain heroes buff each other); destructible map sections; convoy and domination modes; no strict role lock.
build_prompt: Build an original 6v6 third-person hero shooter. 3 roles (tank, damage, support). When certain heroes are on the same team, they unlock team-up abilities (e.g., one charges the other's weapon). Parts of the maps are destructible to open new paths. Payload and capture modes. Comic-book cel-shaded art.

title: Zenless Zone Zero
mechanics: 3-character teams; perfect dodge → dodge counter; daze bar → stun → chain attack (switch characters in sequence); assist parry; TV-screen board exploration; city hangout life sim.
build_prompt: Build an original stylish urban action game: 3-character team, fast combos, perfect dodge triggers slow-motion counters. Build an enemy's daze bar to stun them, then chain attacks: tap to switch characters for a cinematic chain. Between missions, run a video-rental shop in a city hub.

title: Wuthering Waves
mechanics: Echoes (defeat enemies to absorb them as equipable summons with stats); parry counters; wall-run and grapple traversal; intro/outro skills when switching.
build_prompt: Build an original open-world action RPG where defeated enemies can be absorbed as "echoes": equip them for stats and summon them as a skill. Parry counters, wall-running, grappling hook. Switching characters triggers an outro skill from the leaving one and an intro skill from the new one.

title: Deadlock
mechanics: 6v6 across 4 lanes; troopers waves; souls currency from kills/last hits; item shop (weapon, vitality, spirit trees); ziplines; guardians/walkers/patron objectives; parry melee.
build_prompt: Build an original third-person MOBA-shooter: 6v6, lanes with NPC trooper waves, last hits earn currency; buy items from 3 trees (weapon, vitality, spirit) that change abilities. Ziplines over lanes for fast rotation. Destroy guardians → walkers → base core.

title: WEBFISHING
mechanics: Fishing minigame; journal of fish; cosmetic shops; chat bubbles and voice; draw with chalk on the ground; guitar playing.
build_prompt: Build an original cosy multiplayer fishing chat-room: cute animal avatars, fishing minigame (wait for bite, then reel with a tension bar), journal of species and sizes, cosmetic shop, chalk drawing on the ground, a playable guitar.

title: Thronefall
mechanics: Day: build and upgrade houses, towers, walls with gold; Night: enemies attack from shown directions and you fight as a mounted hero; perks and mutators.
build_prompt: Build an original minimalist strategy game: by day, ride around with a hero and spend gold on building spots (houses earn income, towers shoot, barracks spawn units). At night, enemy waves arrive from marked directions and you fight alongside. Low-poly pastel style.

title: Tiny Glade
mechanics: Draw walls and paths; houses auto-shape based on size; drag roofs to change height; windows/doors placed procedurally; no goals.
build_prompt: Build an original relaxing castle builder: draw a wall line and it auto-generates with arches, gates and towers; drag out a house and it shapes itself with roofs, chimneys and windows that adapt; paths, fences and gardens bloom automatically. No goals, just creating dioramas.

title: Nine Sols
mechanics: Deflect-heavy combat (Sekiro-like); deflects charge talisman energy; Azure Bow; unbounded counter; skill tree; hand-drawn art.
build_prompt: Build an original 2D action game focused on deflecting: perfect deflects build charge which powers a talisman blast that deals heavy internal damage. Unblockable attacks require a special counter. Hand-drawn art mixing ancient Eastern motifs and cyberpunk.

title: Little Kitty, Big City
mechanics: Small open city; collect hats; trip humans; steal food; befriend animals (ducklings, crows); nap to recover stamina.
build_prompt: Build an original small open-city adventure as a kitten trying to get home: climb with limited stamina, nap to recover, collect and wear hats, steal food, trip people, help animals with small quests. Hand-painted bright style.

title: Mouthwashing
mechanics: Short first-person story aboard a stranded space truck told non-linearly; minimal interaction; unsettling PS1 visuals.
build_prompt: Build an original short first-person psychological horror narrative aboard a stranded vehicle; scenes jump between "before" and "after" the incident; minimal interaction; low-poly PS1 visuals with harsh colours.

title: The Plucky Squire
mechanics: Characters leap out of a 2D storybook into a 3D desk world; change words in sentences to alter the story; flip pages; minigames.
build_prompt: Build an original storybook adventure: the hero lives in 2D pages but can jump out into a 3D desk world. Swap words in on-page sentences to change the story (a "closed" door becomes "open"). Turn and tilt pages to solve puzzles. Boss fights in different genres.

title: Frostpunk 2
mechanics: Districts instead of single buildings; heat and resources; factions with demands; council votes on laws; tension; frostlands colonies.
build_prompt: Build an original freezing-world city builder: place districts (housing, food, industry, extraction) around a heat generator; manage fuel, food, materials and heat. Factions push laws; you persuade council members before votes. Tension rises with unpopular decisions.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2
mechanics: Thousands of swarm enemies; parry and gun-strike; executions restore armour; 3-player co-op operations; classes.
build_prompt: Build an original third-person co-op horde shooter with thousands of swarming aliens on screen. Melee parry opens enemies for a gun-strike or execution that restores armour. 3-player co-op missions with 6 classes.

title: Silent Hill 2 (Remake)
mechanics: Fog-filled town; radio static when monsters near; melee + scarce firearms; map that the hero annotates; riddles; multiple endings by behaviour.
build_prompt: Build an original foggy psychological horror: a radio crackles when monsters are near; scarce ammo and a melee weapon; a map that auto-annotates explored areas; riddle puzzles with difficulty settings; endings based on hidden player behaviour (health kept low, items examined).

title: Supermarket Simulator
why_it_hit: Satisfying chores + streamer appeal.
mechanics: Order stock via computer; unpack boxes onto shelves; set prices vs market; scan items at checkout and count change/card; hire staff; expand store; licences unlock products; theft.
build_prompt: Build an original first-person shop sim: order boxes on a computer, carry and unpack onto shelves, set prices vs market average, scan items at checkout, count exact change, hire cashiers and restockers, buy licences for new products, expand the store floor.

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
why_it_hit: Deep simulation (hunger, reputation, crime, alchemy by hand) + huge reactive quests.
mechanics: Directional melee with perfect blocks and master strikes; skills improve by doing; reputation per town; clothes get dirty (affects charisma); hand-made alchemy step by step; lockpicking minigames; save by drinking a special potion or sleeping.
design: Photo-real Bohemian countryside; no fantasy; diegetic feel.
build_prompt: Build an original grounded medieval RPG with no magic. Directional sword combat (choose attack direction; perfect block when you match the enemy's direction at the right moment; counter "master strikes"). Skills level by use (reading improves by reading). Hunger, fatigue, and dirty clothes (lower charisma). Crafting potions step-by-step with a recipe book: grind herbs, boil for N turns, add ingredients in order. Towns remember crimes. Saving costs a consumable.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds
mechanics: Seamless open map with dynamic weather/ecosystem; carry 2 weapons; focus mode to target wounds; mount (Seikret) auto-runs to targets; wounds and focus strikes.
build_prompt: Build an original monster-hunting action game in a seamless ecosystem with shifting weather that changes monster behaviour. Hunters carry two weapons and swap on a mount that auto-paths to the target. Hitting the same spot repeatedly opens a wound; aim a focused strike at wounds for big damage and materials. Craft gear sets from monster parts with skill bonuses.

title: Split Fiction
mechanics: Alternates sci-fi and fantasy worlds; each level a new mechanic pair (one gets a gravity whip, the other a sword; dragon riding; cyber-ninja); side stories as genre experiments.
build_prompt: Build an original 2-player co-op adventure where the two heroes are writers trapped in their own stories: one sci-fi, one fantasy. Levels alternate between worlds, each giving complementary new abilities (one swaps gravity, the other shapes time; one becomes a dragon, the other a cyber-ninja). Short side-stories each turn into a different genre (snowboarding, top-down shooter, farm animal transformation).

title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
why_it_hit: French Belle Époque fantasy, stunning art, turn-based fights where you dodge/parry in real time.
mechanics: Turn-based command selection; enemy turns require real-time dodge, parry, jump inputs; counter-attacks on full parry; free-aim shots at weak points; each character has a unique gauge (stances, foretell charges, colour charges); Pictos (passives learned by using them).
design: Painterly surreal landscapes, a giant painted number on a monolith, operatic score.
build_prompt: Build an original turn-based RPG where defense is real-time. On your turn, choose skills (with timing input for bonus). On enemy turns, press dodge or parry at the exact moment of each hit; a fully parried combo triggers a counter-attack. Free-aim mode uses action points to shoot enemy weak points. Each character has a unique resource (one builds stances, one stacks marks, one changes elements). Equip passive gems; after 4 battles their passive is learned permanently. Surreal painterly world.

title: Schedule I
genre: Co-op business sim (crime) — **note:** adapt to a legal product theme for your system
mechanics: Grow/mix products, set prices, recruit dealers, manage customers' addictions/preferences, avoid police, expand property.
build_prompt: Build an original co-op small-business empire sim with a street-food/energy-drink theme. Grow ingredients, mix recipes where each additive adds an effect tag that raises price, text customers who order via a phone app, deliver at meeting points, hire runners who sell for you on routes, buy property and equipment to scale up, while dodging health inspectors who patrol at night.

title: R.E.P.O.
mechanics: Robots carry fragile valuables using physics grab beams; every bump lowers value; monsters; extraction points; proximity voice; shop upgrades.
build_prompt: Build an original co-op physics horror game where players are cute robots retrieving valuables from haunted mansions. A physics grab beam carries objects; collisions reduce the object's value shown on screen. Big items need two players. Monsters hunt by sound. Deliver to extraction points to meet the quota. Proximity voice and goofy robot faces.

title: PEAK
mechanics: Climb a procedurally generated mountain island; stamina bar with injuries/hunger/cold shrinking it; ropes, pitons, food; help friends up; daily changing map.
build_prompt: Build an original co-op climbing game: scouts stranded on an island must climb a mountain to the summit. Stamina bar drains while climbing; injuries, hunger, cold and poison permanently shorten it until treated. Items: rope, piton, energy drink, bandage, campfire. Players can pull each other up. Biomes: beach, jungle, snow, volcano. Map changes daily.

title: Mario Kart World
mechanics: Connected world between tracks; 24 racers; Knockout Tour (eliminations at checkpoints); free roam with P-switch challenges; rail/wall riding; charge jump.
build_prompt: Build an original kart racer where all tracks are connected in one open world; races include driving between tracks. 24 racers. Knockout mode: every checkpoint eliminates the last 4. Drift for boosts, charge jump, grind rails and ride walls. Free-roam mode with 100+ micro-challenges.

title: Donkey Kong Bananza
why_it_hit: Switch 2 showcase; smashing through everything feels amazing.
mechanics: Voxel destruction everything; punch through ground; rip chunks and throw; transformations; layers going down to the planet's core.
build_prompt: Build an original 3D platformer where nearly every surface is destructible voxels: punch, dig down, rip off chunks and throw them, surf on chunks. Transform into animal forms with special destruction powers. Levels are stacked layers descending toward a core.

title: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach
why_it_hit: Unique "strand" genre: connecting players asynchronously through shared structures.
mechanics: Carry cargo with weight/balance (lean to stay upright); terrain read by scanner; build bridges, roads, ladders, ziplines that appear in other players' worlds; likes as currency; weather and terrain hazards (floods, earthquakes); stealth or combat vs bandits; vehicles and monorails.
build_prompt: Build an original delivery game across a rugged wilderness: stack cargo on your back (weight affects balance and stamina — hold triggers to stay upright on slopes). Scan terrain for danger. Place ladders, ropes, bridges and roads that persist and help later deliveries (and other players asynchronously). Weather hazards like flash floods and quakes. Rate deliveries with stars.

title: Assassin's Creed Shadows
mechanics: Two playable heroes: stealthy shinobi (grapple hook, hide in shadows, light extinguishing) and samurai (heavy combat, armour, can't climb as well); seasons change stealth (snow, tall grass); hideout base building; scouts reveal targets; Objectives board.
build_prompt: Build an original stealth open world in feudal Japan-inspired setting with two switchable heroes: a nimble shinobi (grapple hook, crawl, extinguish lights, hide in shadows) and a heavy samurai (brutal melee, parry, breaks doors). Seasons change stealth options (snow leaves footprints, summer has tall grass, winter ponds freeze). A hideout you build with allies and resources.

title: Blue Prince
why_it_hit: Mind-bending layered secrets in a drafting roguelite.
mechanics: Mansion 5×9 grid; each door opened → draft 1 of 3 room cards to place there; rooms have effects (gems spent to draft rare rooms, keys, coins, step costs, shops); limited steps per day; mansion resets each day, knowledge persists; reach "Room 46"; deep riddles.
build_prompt: Build an original roguelike puzzle mansion: a 5×9 grid of empty slots. Each time you open a door, choose one of 3 room cards to place there (rooms have effects: gems, keys, step drains, shops, gardens). You have limited steps per day. The mansion resets every day, but notes, clues and permanent upgrades persist. Goal: reach the hidden final room. Riddles span multiple rooms.

title: Hollow Knight: Silksong
why_it_hit: Most-wishlisted game for years; servers crashed at launch.
mechanics: Fast acrobatic heroine with needle; silk meter to heal (bind) instantly; crests change move sets; tools (craftable throwables); quest board; very hard bosses; currency lost on death (retrieve).
build_prompt: Build an original 2D hand-drawn bug-kingdom metroidvania with a fast acrobatic hero. Attacking fills a silk meter used to heal instantly or cast skills. Equip "crests" that change attack patterns. Craftable tools with limited uses. Towns with quest boards. Hard bosses with readable windups. Currency lost on death, recoverable at your cocoon.

title: Hades II
mechanics: Witch heroine with magick gauge for omega (charged) moves; two routes (underworld down, surface up); gather herbs, ores, fish with tools; incantations at a crossroads cauldron unlock features; arcana cards (deck-based meta); boons from gods; familiars.
build_prompt: Build an original sequel-style isometric roguelite: a witch heroine with a mana gauge — hold attack/special to charge "omega" versions that cost mana. Two routes per run (descend or ascend), each with 4 biomes. Gather herbs and ores with tools during runs. A hub cauldron where you cook incantations that permanently add features. A meta-upgrade card grid with a point cost.

title: Ghost of Yōtei
mechanics: Revenge list of targets; multiple weapon types (katana, dual katana, odachi, yari, kusarigama) — each strong vs certain enemies; campfire stories; sketching, shamisen music minigames; wolf companion; flexible open world without guided icons.
build_prompt: Build an original revenge open-world samurai game: a list of 6 targets with portraits; weapons (katana, dual blades, long sword, spear, chain-sickle) each counter certain enemy types; disarm and pick up enemy weapons; camp at fires to hear stories pointing to secrets; sketching and string-instrument minigames; wolf companion.

title: Battlefield 6
why_it_hit: "Back to roots" with classes and destruction; record launch.
mechanics: 4 classes (Assault, Engineer, Support, Recon) with signature gadgets; tactical destruction; drag-and-revive; vehicles; Conquest and Breakthrough modes; Portal custom modes; battle royale.
build_prompt: Build an original large-scale shooter with 4 classes (assault, engineer with repair tool and anti-vehicle, support with ammo/heal and revive by dragging, recon with spotting drones), destructible building walls and floors, vehicles, and Conquest (capture flags) and Breakthrough (attackers push sectors) modes.

title: DOOM: The Dark Ages
mechanics: Shield saw (block, parry green projectiles, throw to stun, shield charge dash); heavier "stand and fight" combat; melee weapons (flail, mace); cyber-dragon flight sections; giant mech fights; difficulty sliders for speed, damage, parry window.
build_prompt: Build an original medieval-tech arena shooter: a shield saw that blocks, parries green projectiles back, can be thrown to stun or cut armour, and charges at distant enemies. Melee weapons with combo charges. Flying-mount sections and giant-mech kaiju fights. Difficulty sliders for game speed, enemy damage and parry window.

title: Elden Ring Nightreign
mechanics: 3-player runs of 3 in-game days (~40 min); shrinking circle each day; level fast from 1 to ~15; loot weapons with random passives; 8 hero classes with ult skills; night bosses end each day; final boss on day 3; map events.
build_prompt: Build an original 3-player co-op dark fantasy roguelite: each run is 3 in-game days on a compact map with a shrinking storm circle. Level up rapidly, grab random weapons with passives, clear camps and forts. Each night ends with a boss; day 3 ends with the final boss. 8 hero classes with unique skills and ultimates.

title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
mechanics: Skill-based leveling (use skills to raise them); spellmaking (combine effects); guild questlines (Fighters, Mages, Thieves, Dark Brotherhood); demonic gates to close; horse travel; persuasion wheel.
build_prompt: Build an original open-world fantasy RPG with use-based skill leveling, a spellmaking altar where you combine effects (fire + slow + duration) into custom spells, 4 guild questlines, and random portal gates spawning demon realms that must be closed.

title: Dune: Awakening
mechanics: Water scarcity (sweat, stillsuits, water reclamation); sandworms attracted by rhythmic movement on sand; shields; ornithopters; base building; spice harvesting; deep desert PvP; sandstorms.
build_prompt: Build an original desert-planet survival game: hydration drains (craft suits to recycle moisture); giant sand creatures attracted by rhythmic footsteps on open sand (stay on rocks, walk irregularly); personal energy shields; craft flying vehicles; harvest a valuable resource in contested zones; sandstorms reshape the map.

title: REMATCH
mechanics: Each player controls one footballer in third-person; no fouls/offside; walls around pitch; free aim shooting/passing; goalkeeper role rotates.
build_prompt: Build an original 5v5 arcade football game where each player controls one athlete in third person. No offside or fouls; the ball bounces off arena walls; manual aiming for passes and shots; lob, chip and volley; goalkeeper can rush out. 6-minute matches with golden goal.

title: Dispatch
why_it_hit: TV-quality episodic animation + clever management gameplay.
mechanics: Choose which heroes to dispatch to emergencies based on stats, synergy and personality; heroes need rest; story choices; hacking minigame; relationships.
build_prompt: Build an original superhero-dispatch office game: a city map pings emergencies with a description; drag heroes with stats (combat, speed, charisma, intellect, vigor) onto calls; outcomes depend on stats and team chemistry; heroes need rest and can get injured; between shifts, story episodes with choices; a hacking minigame for tech calls.

title: ARC Raiders
why_it_hit: Massive hit; players choosing cooperation or betrayal created viral moments.
mechanics: Surface raids vs giant machine enemies (flying drones, huge walkers) and other players; loot and extract via elevators/trains; underground hub; crafting benches; proximity voice; gear loss on death; free loadout option.
build_prompt: Build an original third-person extraction shooter: go topside, loot ruins, avoid huge robot patrols that hear gunfire, and reach an extraction lift before the timer. Other players can help or betray (proximity voice). Death loses carried gear. Underground hub with crafting benches and quests.

title: Megabonk
mechanics: Auto-attack weapons; movement tech (bunny hop, sliding, jump pads); shrines (charge for buffs); chests with keys; tomes (stat passives); 10-minute stages with boss; silly low-poly character roster.
build_prompt: Build an original 3D low-poly survivors-like: auto-attacking weapons, jump/slide/bunny-hop movement, shrines you stand in to charge buffs, chests needing gold, stat tomes, scaling hordes, a boss at 10 minutes. Goofy character roster with unique starting weapons.

title: BALL x PIT
mechanics: Shoot balls upward at descending enemy formations; balls bounce and return; level-ups give new ball types; fuse two balls to evolve; characters with unique fire patterns; base-building between runs (harvest resources, build structures for bonuses).
build_prompt: Build an original brick-breaker roguelite: shoot bouncing balls upward at enemy formations that slowly advance downward. Level up to gain new ball types (fire, ice, poison, splitting); fuse two max-level balls into an evolved type. Characters have different shooting styles. Between runs, a base-builder where you place buildings that give run bonuses.

title: Pokémon Legends: Z-A
genre: Real-time creature action RPG in one city
mechanics: Real-time battles (moves on cooldowns, positioning, dodging); night "battle zones" ranking ladder; wild zones in the city; mega evolution; rooftops traversal.
build_prompt: Build an original real-time creature battler set in one big city: during battles creatures use moves on cooldowns while the trainer moves around to dodge. At night, designated battle zones host a ranking ladder against other trainers. Wild creatures roam fenced city zones.

title: Kirby Air Riders
mechanics: Auto-acceleration; one button to brake/charge boost and to inhale; City Trial mode (5 minutes collecting power-ups in an open city, then a random final event); machines with stat profiles.
build_prompt: Build an original one-button party racing game: riders auto-accelerate; hold the button to brake and charge a boost; steer to drift. Main mode: 5 minutes roaming an open city collecting stat power-ups, then a random final event (race, battle, high jump) using your built-up machine.

title: Escape from Duckov
why_it_hit: Cute parody of hardcore extraction shooters, approachable solo.
mechanics: Raid zones; loot with weight; extract points; base upgrades (workbench, medical station); quests from NPCs; weapon modding; storms and hunger.
build_prompt: Build an original top-down single-player extraction shooter with cute ducks: raid zones with loot weight limits, AI enemies and bosses, extraction points; back at the bunker upgrade workbenches and a stash; NPC quests; gun attachments.

title: Grow a Garden (Roblox)
why_it_hit: Simplest idle loop on Roblox; record concurrent player counts (20M+).
mechanics: Buy seeds from rotating stock; plant; crops grow in real-time even offline; weather mutations multiply value; sell; pets with passives; trading; events.
build_prompt: Build an original multiplayer idle gardening game: buy seeds from a shop whose stock rotates every 5 minutes, plant on a personal plot, crops grow in real time (even offline), weather events give mutations (golden, rainbow, frozen) that multiply value, sell for coins, collect pets with passive boosts, trade with other players.

title: Steal a Brainrot (Roblox)
mechanics: Meme characters walk down a conveyor; buy them to place in your base where they earn cash/second; rarer = more income; steal from other players' bases; timed base lock; rebirths.
build_prompt: Build an original multiplayer idle-steal game: weird characters walk along a central conveyor; buy them to place on pedestals in your base where they earn coins per second (rarer = more). Run into other players' bases to steal characters while their lock timer is down; carry them back while being chased. Rebirth for multipliers.

title: 99 Nights in the Forest (Roblox)
mechanics: Keep campfire alive; gather wood and scrap; craft; rescue lost children in the forest; a deer-monster hunts at night (use flashlight); classes; upgrade campfire radius.
build_prompt: Build an original co-op survival game: keep a campfire burning through as many nights as possible; gather wood and scrap by day; craft tools and traps; rescue lost kids in the forest; at night a monster stalks and can be held back with a flashlight beam. Upgrading the fire expands the safe radius.

title: Bongo Cat
why_it_hit: Peaked among the most-played Steam games; free, cute, runs while you work.
mechanics: Cat sits on the screen edge and taps along with every key press; points → random cosmetic drops; tradeable hats.
build_prompt: Build an original idle desktop pet: a small cat sits at the edge of the screen and paws along with each key/click you make; every N presses gives a chest with random cosmetic hats and outfits; an inventory to equip them.

title: Silent Hill f
mechanics: 1960s Japanese town covered in red flower corruption; melee-only combat with weapon durability; focus mode for counters; sanity meter; omamori charms; otherworld shrine.
build_prompt: Build an original horror game set in a rural mountain town consumed by spreading red flowers: melee-only combat with breakable weapons, a focus mode that slows time for counters but drains sanity, charm slots for passive buffs, and a mysterious shrine otherworld.

title: Borderlands 4
mechanics: Procedurally generated guns from manufacturers (each with traits: elemental, charge-up, smart bullets); grapple, glide, double jump, dash; 4 Vault Hunters with 3 skill trees; seamless open world; 4-player co-op.
build_prompt: Build an original looter-shooter: guns are generated from parts with rarity and manufacturer traits (smart bullets, thrown-reload, elemental). Movement includes grapple, glide, double jump and dash. 4 heroes with 3 skill trees each. Comic-shaded art, 4-player co-op.

title: Hytale
why_it_hit: Years of hype, revived after cancellation; Minecraft-style building with real RPG combat and built-in modding.
mechanics: Block building and mining; zones with biomes and dungeons; melee/ranged combat with weapon movesets and dodges; creatures with behaviours; farming and taming; server-side modding and minigame servers; in-game model/animation tools.
design: Chunky, colourful voxels with smoother characters, warm fantasy palette.
build_prompt: Build an original voxel sandbox adventure. World generated in zones (meadow, desert, frozen, volcanic) with dungeons and bosses. Mine and place blocks freely. Combat has weapon-specific combos, charged attacks, block and dodge roll. Tame and farm creatures. Include a simple in-game editor where players create custom minigames (spawn points, teams, win conditions). Chunky colourful voxels with rounded character models.

title: Arknights: Endfield
mechanics: Real-time party of 4 with skill chains; build automated production lines (miners, conveyors, processors, power towers) in the field; outposts; resource networks between regions.
build_prompt: Build an original sci-fi action RPG where exploration combines real-time 4-character combat (swap, chain skills, ultimate) with base automation: place miners on ore, connect conveyors to processors and power pylons to produce gear and consumables automatically. Outposts connect into a regional logistics network.

title: Code Vein II
why_it_hit: Sequel to a cult hit that made the souls formula friendlier with partners.
mechanics: Switchable class sets ("blood codes") that change stats and skills; drain attacks restore skill energy; AI partner fights alongside and can revive you; time-travel story jumping between eras; character creator.
build_prompt: Build an original anime-styled souls-like: switch classes ("codes") anytime at checkpoints, each with its own skill list; drain attacks and backstabs restore your skill energy; an AI partner fights alongside and can revive you once per checkpoint; the story jumps between past and present versions of the same areas. Deep character creator.

title: Nioh 3
mechanics: Swap between samurai style (stances, ki pulse stamina recovery) and ninja style (fast, tools); open field areas; yokai realm corruption zones; loot with rarities.
build_prompt: Build an original hardcore samurai-yokai action game with two fighting styles you swap anytime: heavy stance-based sword style (high/mid/low stances, stamina recovery by timing a pulse after combos) and agile ninja style (dash, throwing tools). Demon corruption zones reduce stamina regen until you destroy their source. Diablo-like loot drops.

title: Resident Evil Requiem
mechanics: Switchable first/third-person; vulnerable protagonist; resource scarcity; stalker enemy; puzzles; safe rooms.
build_prompt: Build an original survival horror game in a decaying hotel/hospital. Player is not a soldier: weak melee, scarce ammo, hide in lockers. An unkillable stalker roams and hears noise. Grid inventory, key-item puzzles, typewriter-style save rooms. Toggle first/third-person camera.

title: Mewgenics
mechanics: Breed cats inheriting stats/mutations; send squads of 4 on turn-based grid adventures; classes via collars; cats age and die; deep random interactions.
build_prompt: Build an original turn-based tactics roguelike with cats. In your house, cats breed overnight and kittens inherit stats, abilities and mutations (extra legs, odd eyes) from parents. Pick 4 cats, give each a class collar (fighter, mage, tank, hunter), and send them on grid-battle adventures. Cats that return gain traits; cats age and retire. Gross-out comedic art style.

title: Slay the Spire 2
mechanics: Map of branching paths (fights, elites, events, shops, rest sites); turn-based card combat with energy; enemy intent shown; relics; co-op mode; new characters.
build_prompt: Build an original roguelike deckbuilder. Climb a branching map of nodes (battle, elite, event, merchant, campfire, treasure). Combat: 3 energy per turn, draw 5 cards (attack, block, power). Enemies show their next intent (attack 12, buff, debuff). Win → choose 1 of 3 cards. Relics give permanent passives. Campfire: heal or upgrade a card. Boss at the end of each act. Optional 2-player co-op where players share targets.

title: Marathon
why_it_hit: Bungie's gunplay + a striking acid-graphic-design art style.
mechanics: Runner "shells" (classes) with prime/tactical abilities; 3-person crews drop onto a lost colony planet; loot, fight AI security and rival crews; extract to keep loot; contracts from factions; gear risk.
build_prompt: Build an original sci-fi extraction shooter with bold graphic-design visuals (acid colours, big typography, UI-like environments). Pick a cyber "shell" class with abilities (cloak, drone, barrier, dash), drop with a 3-person crew, loot, fight AI security and rival crews, and reach extraction. Everything you carry is lost on death. Faction contracts give goals.

title: Crimson Desert
mechanics: Combo combat mixing swordplay with wrestling grapples and throws; huge bosses; horse riding and mounted combat; climbing and gliding; lots of world interactions (cooking, fishing, crafting).
build_prompt: Build an original open-world fantasy action game where sword combos blend with wrestling moves (grab, suplex, throw enemies into each other). Giant bosses with phases. Horse riding with mounted combat, climbing, gliding with a cape, cooking and fishing. Gritty realistic medieval look.

title: Pokémon Pokopia
mechanics: A shape-shifting creature rebuilds an empty world; learns abilities from befriended creatures; building, crafting, habitats that attract new residents.
build_prompt: Build an original cosy life-sim where a shape-shifting creature rebuilds an empty world: learn abilities from creatures you befriend (water to grow plants, cut trees, light fires), build houses and habitats, attract creatures to move in, and craft furniture to decorate. No combat, gentle goals.

title: Saros
mechanics: Eclipse cycle that changes the planet and makes enemies stronger; shield absorbs some projectiles to power a counter-weapon; permanent upgrades between runs; dense bullet patterns.
build_prompt: Build an original third-person bullet-hell roguelite on a cursed planet with an eclipse cycle that transforms biomes and empowers enemies. A shield absorbs certain coloured projectiles to charge a powerful counter-weapon. Permanent upgrades persist between runs. Neon bullets on dark terrain.

title: Pragmata
mechanics: Shoot enemies while a companion android hacks them via a quick grid puzzle that opens weak points.
build_prompt: Build an original sci-fi third-person shooter on a lunar station: a spacesuited hero protects an android girl. While aiming at an enemy, a small grid-hacking puzzle appears (trace a path through nodes in seconds); completing it opens armour for big damage. Mix hacking and shooting under pressure.

title: 007 First Light
mechanics: Social stealth (blend in, talk past guards), gadgets, disguises, multiple approaches per mission, vehicle chases, hand-to-hand fights.
build_prompt: Build an original young-spy action game: social stealth (blend into crowds, talk your way past guards with dialogue choices), gadgets (laser watch, tracking pen), disguises, several approaches per mission, car chases and close-quarters fights.

title: Forza Horizon 6
mechanics: Festival progression; mountain touge roads and drift battles; dense neon city; seasons; car meets and tuning culture; player houses/garages.
build_prompt: Build an original open-world festival racer set in a stylised island nation: mountain touge roads with drift battles, dense neon city streets, seasons with cherry blossom and snow; car meet-ups, tuning culture, and skill chains for points.

title: Block Blast!
why_it_hit: No timer, satisfying line clears, ultra-short sessions.
mechanics: 8×8 grid; 3 random shapes per turn; place all 3; full rows/columns clear; combo for multiple lines; game over if no shape fits.
build_prompt: Build an original 8×8 block puzzle. Each turn offers 3 random polyomino shapes; drag each onto the grid. Completed rows or columns clear with a burst; multiple clears in one move = combo multiplier; consecutive-move clears = streak. Game over when none of the remaining shapes fit. Jewel-like glossy blocks, juicy particles and sound.

title: Survivor.io
mechanics: One-thumb movement; auto skills; skill pairs evolve (weapon + passive); 15-minute chapters with bosses; gear between runs; energy system.
build_prompt: Build an original mobile one-thumb survivors-like: 15-minute chapters, auto-firing skills, pick 1 of 3 skills on level-up, weapons evolve when paired with their matching passive at max level, bosses at minutes 5/10/15, and gear slots (weapon, armour, ring) upgraded between runs.

title: NYT Connections
mechanics: 16 words, find 4 groups of 4; 4 mistakes allowed; colour-coded difficulty; "one away" hint; share grid.
build_prompt: Build an original daily grouping puzzle: 16 word tiles; find 4 hidden groups of 4 (difficulty yellow → green → blue → purple). Select 4 and submit; 4 mistakes allowed; "one away" hint. Shuffle button. Shareable emoji result grid; daily seed by date.

title: Squad Busters
mechanics: 10 players; walk around collecting characters that join your growing squad (merge 3 into a super version); open chests with coins; fight others to steal gems; most gems after ~4 minutes wins.
build_prompt: Build an original mobile 10-player squad battle: walk around collecting characters from chests that join your growing squad (3 of the same merge into a stronger version), gather gems, fight other squads to steal their gems; biggest gem pile after 4 minutes wins.

title: Pokémon TCG Pocket
mechanics: Open 2 free packs per day with swipe animation; "immersive" animated cards; Wonder Pick from friends' packs; 20-card decks; energy auto-generated; 3 points win.
build_prompt: Build an original mobile collectible card game: open 2 free packs per day with a satisfying swipe-to-tear animation; rare cards have 3D parallax art that zooms into a scene. 20-card decks; one energy generated automatically each turn; knocking out creatures scores points; first to 3 points wins.

title: Capybara Go!
mechanics: Auto-progress through days; each day a random event with 2–3 choices (fight, gamble, rest, gain skill); auto-battles; boss days; gear between runs.
build_prompt: Build an original mobile "choose-your-event" roguelike: tap to advance a day; each day presents a random event with 2–3 choices (fight a monster, spin a wheel, rest, learn a skill, buy item). Battles auto-resolve with animated attacks. Boss every 10 days; gear and pets upgrade between runs.

title: Last War: Survival / Whiteout Survival
genre: Mobile 4X strategy with hybrid minigame ads
mechanics: Gate-math runner minigame (choose ×2 or +10 gates to grow army) leading into base-building; heroes; alliances; timed upgrades; PvP world map.
build_prompt: Build an original mobile hybrid: a runner minigame where your crowd passes through math gates (×2, +10, −5) and fights enemy crowds, feeding into a base-building strategy layer with hero upgrades, building timers and alliance events.

title: DOORS (Roblox)
mechanics: 100 procedurally generated hotel rooms; each monster has a rule (hide in closets when lights flicker, don't look at it, stay still); key items; shops; co-op revival.
build_prompt: Build an original co-op horror run through 100 procedurally generated hotel rooms. Each monster has one rule (hide in closets when lights flicker; don't look at it; stand still when you hear whispers). Find keys to open locked doors; a shop sells flashlights and lockpicks before the run.

title: Dress to Impress (Roblox)
mechanics: Theme announced; 5 minutes in a dressing room with clothing, makeup, hair; runway walk with poses; players vote with stars; level up and earn money.
build_prompt: Build an original multiplayer fashion contest: a theme is announced, players have 5 minutes in a dressing room (outfits, colours, hair, makeup, accessories), then walk a runway with poses while others vote with 1–5 stars. Winners earn coins for new clothing.

title: Fisch (Roblox)
mechanics: Cast with power meter; reel with a moving-bar minigame; rods with stats (luck, control, resilience); islands with species; weather and time affect catches; bestiary; mutations.
build_prompt: Build an original multiplayer fishing RPG: hold to charge a cast, then keep a moving reel bar over the fish icon to fill the catch meter. Rods have luck/control/resilience stats. Islands, weather and time of day change which fish appear. Bestiary with rare mutations.

title: Fortnite
mechanics: 100-player BR; instant building (walls, ramps, floors, roofs) from harvested materials; Zero Build mode; seasonal live events and map changes; battle pass; creative/UEFN user maps; LEGO, racing and festival modes.
build_prompt: Build an original cartoony battle royale where players harvest materials and instantly build walls, ramps and floors for cover and height, with a no-build mode, seasonal map changes, live one-time events, and a battle pass of cosmetics.

title: Minecraft
mechanics: Mine blocks, craft in a 3×3 grid, build anything; day/night with hostile mobs at night; hunger; biomes; redstone logic circuits; enchanting; farming and villagers; creative mode.
build_prompt: Build an original voxel survival-creative game: mine blocks, craft in a grid, build freely; nights spawn monsters; hunger bar; biomes; a logic-wire system for doors, traps and machines; farming and village traders; a creative mode with infinite blocks.

title: Roblox
mechanics: Avatar economy; millions of user experiences; obby, tycoon, simulator, roleplay, horror genres; Studio editor with Lua scripting.
build_prompt: Build an original mini-game hub: a lobby where players pick from several small games (obby, tycoon, tag, quiz); earn coins across all of them; customise a shared avatar; leaderboard per game.

title: Grand Theft Auto V / Online
mechanics: Open city; vehicles of all kinds; wanted-level system; 3 switchable protagonists; heists with planning setups; businesses; online roleplay communities.
build_prompt: Build an original open-world city sandbox (reskin as a "movie stunt crew" to keep it non-criminal): drive any vehicle, a wanted/attention meter when you cause chaos, multi-step "big job" missions with planning setups, businesses that earn passive income, and a free-roam multiplayer mode.

title: Rocket League
mechanics: Rocket-boost cars; jump, double jump, flip; aerial hits; wall driving; demolitions; 3v3, 5-minute matches; ranked; cosmetics.
build_prompt: Build an original car football game: rocket-boost cars with jump, double-jump/flip, aerial flying with boost, wall driving and demolitions; giant ball physics; 3v3, 5-minute matches with overtime golden goal; boost pads around the arena.

title: Apex Legends
mechanics: Trios; legends with tactical/passive/ultimate abilities; contextual ping system; respawn beacons (collect banners); sliding and climbing movement; armour evolving with damage.
build_prompt: Build an original squad hero battle royale: teams of 3, each hero with a tactical, passive and ultimate; contextual ping wheel (enemy here, loot here); collect fallen teammates' banners to respawn them at beacons; slide-jump movement and wall climbing; armour that upgrades with damage dealt.
